zh.summary: 直接监督并协调零售销售以外销售人员的活动；除监督职责外，还可能承担预算、会计与人事等工作：包括监控销售人员绩效以确保达成目标；在员工执行困难或复杂职责时提供协助；指导与监督从事销售、盘点、核对现金收入或提供特定服务的员工；倾听并解决客户关于服务与产品或人员的投诉；保存与采购、销售和申购有关的记录；招聘、培训与评估人员；与公司管理人员沟通以制定提高销售、扩大市场与促进业务的方法与流程；制定并准备工作排班并把员工分配到具体职责；参加公司会议以交流产品信息并与其他部门协调工作；拜访零售商与销售代表以推广产品并收集信息；根据盈利要求制定商品定价政策；为管理层与预算部门编制销售与库存报告；检查为转售采购或为存储收到的产品以确定产品状况；检查商品以确保定价与陈列正确且功能与宣传相符；分析销售区域细节以评估其增长潜力并设定配额；盘点库存并在库存降至指定水平时补货；协调促销活动，如准备商品陈列与广告文案；编制租赁或租借协议，明确机械与工具或其他物品使用费用与付款程序。

en.name: First-Line Supervisors of Office and Administrative Support Workers
en.summary: Directly supervise and coordinate the work activities of clerical and administrative support personnel: supervise the work of office, administrative, or customer service employees to ensure compliance with quality standards, deadlines, and procedures and correct them when errors or problems arise; resolve customer complaints or answer customers' questions about policies and procedures; provide guidance to employees on handling difficult or complex problems or on defusing escalated complaints and disputes; review records or reports concerning production, payroll, shipping, and the like to verify details, monitor work activities, or evaluate performance; discuss performance problems with employees to identify causes and resolve them; prepare and issue work schedules, deadlines, and task assignments for office or administrative staff; recruit, interview, and select employees; explain and communicate work procedures and company policies to staff; evaluate employee performance and compliance and recommend corresponding personnel actions; train or instruct employees in job duties and company policies or arrange training; research, compile, and prepare reports, manuals, correspondence, or other materials as required by management or government agencies; implement company or departmental policies, procedures, and service standards together with management personnel; compute figures such as balances, totals, and commissions; coordinate activities with other supervisors or with other work units or departments; participate in the work of subordinates to improve efficiency or overcome difficult links in the work; advise management on issues such as staffing or procedural changes; develop or update procedures, policies, or standards; maintain records such as inventory, personnel, orders, supplies, and equipment maintenance; consult with managers or other personnel to resolve problems such as equipment performance, output quality, and work scheduling; develop work schedules based on budgets and workloads; analyze the financial activities of the establishment or department and provide input for budget preparation and preparation; design, implement, or evaluate employee training and development programs, customer service initiatives, or performance measurement standards; understand the terms of labor agreements and their impact on departmental operations; coordinate or perform activities related to transportation, receiving, distribution, or shipping; monitor inventory levels and requisition or purchase supplies as needed; plan or coordinate office services such as the procurement or organization of equipment or supplies, asset disposal, relocation, parking, maintenance, or security services; arrange necessary maintenance or repair work; and plan the layout of stockrooms, warehouses, or other storage areas after considering factors such as turnover, size, and weight.

zh.name: 行政办公支持一线主管
zh.summary: 直接监督并协调文书及行政支持人员的工作活动：监督办公室、行政或客户服务员工的工作以确保符合质量标准、截止期限与规程并在出错或出问题时纠正；解决客户投诉或解答客户关于政策与程序的疑问；就处理困难或复杂问题或化解升级的投诉与争议向员工提供指导；审阅生产与薪酬与运输等有关记录或报告以核实细节、监控工作活动或评估绩效；与员工讨论绩效问题以找出原因并解决；为办公室或行政人员编制并发布工作排班、截止期限与任务分派；招聘、面试与选拔员工；向员工解释并传达工作程序与公司政策；评估员工绩效与合规情况并建议相应人事处理；培训或指导员工的工作职责与公司政策或安排培训；按管理层或政府机构要求研究、汇总并编制报告、手册、函件或其他资料；与管理人员共同实施公司或部门政策、程序与服务标准；计算余额与合计与佣金等数字；与其他主管人员或其他工作单元或部门协调活动；参与下属的工作以提高效率或克服工作中的困难环节；就人员配置或程序变更等问题向管理层提出建议；制定或更新程序、政策或标准；维护库存与人员与订单与供应与设备维护等记录；与经理或其他人员协商解决设备性能与产出质量与工作排班等问题；根据预算与工作量制定工作排班；分析机构或部门的财务活动并为预算编制与准备提供输入；设计、实施或评估员工培训与发展计划、客户服务举措或绩效衡量标准；了解劳资协议条款及其对部门运作的影响；协调或执行与运输、收货、配送或运输有关的活动；监控库存水平并按需申购或采购供应品；规划或协调办公服务，如设备或供应品的采购或组织、资产处置、搬迁、停车、维护或安保服务；安排必要的维护或维修工作；在考虑周转率与尺寸与重量等因素的前提下规划库房与仓库或其他储存区域的布局。

en.name: First-Line Supervisors of Passenger Attendants
en.summary: Supervise and coordinate the activities of passenger attendants: enforce safety rules and regulations; resolve customer complaints about employee performance or the services provided; inspect materials and inventory and vehicles and equipment and facilities to ensure they are safe, defect-free, and meet specifications; train employees in operating procedures and functions and explain company policies; compute or estimate cash and compensation and transportation or staffing needs; inspect work areas or operating equipment to ensure they meet established standards for cleanliness or maintenance; recommend and implement measures to improve employee motivation and work methods or customer service; meet with managers or other supervisors to learn about changes affecting operations; explain the interests or special needs of specific groups to employees; observe and evaluate employee appearance and performance to ensure service quality and compliance with specifications; explain and demonstrate work tasks to new employees or assign training tasks to experienced employees; take disciplinary measures to address performance problems; analyze and record personnel or operations data and write reports on activities; confer with customers and supervisors and contractors or other personnel to exchange information or resolve problems; apply customer feedback to service improvement; participate in continuing education to keep up with industry trends and developments; request necessary supplies and equipment or services; direct or coordinate the activities of employees, such as flight or train crew members; and recruit and hire employees.

zh.name: 乘客服务员一线主管
zh.summary: 监督并协调乘客服务员的活动：执行安全规则与规程；解决客户关于员工表现或所提供服务的投诉；检查物料与库存与车辆与设备与设施以确保安全、无缺陷且符合规格；培训员工掌握操作规程与职能并解释公司政策；计算或估算现金与薪酬与运输或人员需求；检查工作区域或运行设备以确保在清洁或维护等方面符合既定标准；建议并实施提高员工积极性与工作方法或客户服务的措施；与经理或其他主管会面以了解影响运营的变化；向员工说明特定群体的利益或特殊需要；观察并评估员工的仪容与表现以确保服务质量并符合规格；向新员工解释并示范工作任务或向有经验的员工分配培训任务；为处理绩效问题采取纪律措施；分析与记录人员或运营数据并撰写有关活动报告；与客户与主管与承包商或其他人员商谈以交换信息或解决问题；将客户反馈应用于服务改进；参加继续教育以了解行业趋势与发展；申请必要的供应品与设备或服务；指导或协调员工的活动，如空中或车厢乘务人员；招聘与雇用员工。

en.name: First-Line Supervisors of Personal Service Workers
en.summary: Supervise and coordinate the activities of personal service workers: train employees in operating procedures and functions and explain company policies; meet with managers or other supervisors to learn about changes affecting operations; assign work schedules according to work needs to ensure the quality and timely delivery of services; recruit and hire employees; resolve customer complaints about employee performance or the services provided; take disciplinary measures to address performance problems; inspect work areas or operating equipment to ensure they meet established standards for cleanliness or maintenance; investigate employee complaints and resolve problems according to management rules and regulations; observe and evaluate employee appearance and performance to ensure service quality and compliance with specifications; direct or coordinate the activities of employees, such as hotel staff or hairstylists; participate in continuing education to keep up with industry trends and developments; inform management about issues such as employee disputes; schedule employee breaks to ensure adequate staffing of service personnel for each shift; apply customer feedback to service improvement; explain the interests or special needs of specific groups to employees; request necessary supplies and equipment or services; and direct marketing and advertising or other customer recruitment efforts.

zh.name: 个人服务工人一线主管
zh.summary: 监督并协调个人服务工人的活动：培训员工掌握操作规程与职能并解释公司政策；与经理或其他主管会面以了解影响运营的变化；按工作需求分配工作排班以确保服务的质量与及时交付；招聘与雇用员工；解决客户关于员工表现或所提供服务的投诉；为处理绩效问题采取纪律措施；检查工作区域或运行设备以确保在清洁或维护等方面符合既定标准；调查员工投诉并依管理规则与规定解决问题；观察并评估员工的仪容与表现以确保服务质量并符合规格；指导或协调员工的活动，如酒店员工或发型师；参加继续教育以了解行业趋势与发展；就员工争议等问题向管理层通报；安排员工休息以确保每个班次的服务人员配备充足；将客户反馈应用于服务改进；向员工说明特定群体的利益或特殊需要；申请必要的供应品与设备或服务；指导营销与广告或其他客户招募工作。

en.name: First-Line Supervisors of Police and Detectives
en.summary: Directly supervise and coordinate the activities of members of a police force: supervise and coordinate the investigation of criminal cases, provide guidance and professional opinions to investigators, and ensure that procedures are conducted in accordance with laws and regulations; prepare work schedules and assign tasks to subordinates; direct the collection, preparation, and handling of evidence and the personal property of persons in custody; investigate and resolve personnel problems within the organization and allegations of misconduct by employees; explain police operations to subordinates to assist them in performing their duties; maintain logs, prepare reports, and direct the preparation, processing, and maintenance of departmental records; inform personnel about changes in regulations and policies, the impact of new or revised laws, and new techniques in police work; train employees in proper police procedures; impose disciplinary action on employees who violate departmental rules; monitor and evaluate the work performance of subordinates and approve promotions and transfers; review the content of written orders to ensure compliance with legal requirements; conduct spot checks and order the detention of witnesses and suspects for questioning; cooperate with court personnel and officials of other law enforcement agencies as necessary and testify in court; meet with citizens and educational and community groups to conduct community programs and activities and discuss law enforcement issues; inspect facilities and supplies and vehicles and equipment to ensure compliance with standards; direct the release or transfer of persons in custody; requisition and issue equipment and supplies; develop, implement, and revise departmental policies and procedures; prepare press releases and reply to police correspondence; prepare budgets and manage departmental expenditures; and read and review subordinates' reports to ensure they meet legal standards and contain no errors.

zh.name: 警察与侦探一线主管
zh.summary: 直接监督并协调警察部队成员的活动：监督并协调刑事案件的侦查，向侦查人员提供指导与专业意见，并确保程序依法律与法规进行；编制工作排班并向下属分配任务；指导证据与在押人员个人财物的收集、准备与处理；调查并解决组织内的人员问题与对员工的失当行为指控；向下属说明警务运作以协助其履行职责；维护日志、编制报告并指导部门记录的准备、处理与维护；向人员通报法规与政策的变化、新订或修订法律的影响以及警务工作的新技术；按正当警务程序培训员工；对违反部门规章的员工给予纪律处分；监控并评估下属的工作绩效并批准晋升与调任；审阅书面命令内容以确保符合法律要求；实施突击检查并下令拘留证人与嫌疑人以接受询问；必要时与法院人员及其他执法机构官员合作并在法庭作证；与公民与教育及社区团体开会以开展社区项目与活动并讨论执法议题；检查设施与物资与车辆与设备以确保符合标准；指导在押人员的释放或移交；申请并发放设备与物资；制定、实施并修订部门政策与程序；编制新闻稿并回复警务函件；编制预算并管理部门经费支出；阅读并审阅下属报告以确保符合法律标准且没有错误。

en.name: First-Line Supervisors of Production and Operating Workers
en.summary: Directly supervise and coordinate the work of production and operating personnel, such as inspectors, precision workers, machine setters and operators, assemblers, fabricators, and plant and system operators (excluding team or work leaders): enforce safety and sanitation regulations; keep records of employee attendance and hours worked; inspect materials and products or equipment to detect defects or malfunctions; read and analyze charts and work orders and production schedules and other records and reports to determine production requirements and to evaluate current production estimates and outputs; develop and establish work schedules and task assignments and production sequences to meet production goals; confer with other supervisors to coordinate operations and activities within or between departments; explain specifications and drawings and work orders and company policies and procedures to workers; observe work and monitor indicators such as gauges and dials to ensure that operators conform to production or processing standards; direct and coordinate the activities of employees engaged in the production or processing of goods, such as inspectors and machine setters and fabricators; conduct employee training in equipment operations or work and safety procedures or assign training to experienced employees; evaluate employee performance; confer with management or subordinates to resolve worker problems and complaints and grievances; determine standards and budgets and production goals and quotas according to company policies and equipment and staffing availability and workload; compute labor and equipment requirements and production specifications using standard formulas; recommend or implement measures to motivate employees and to improve production methods or equipment performance or product quality or efficiency; maintain operations data such as hours worked and production and cost and prepare management reports of production results; requisition materials and supplies and equipment parts or repair services; set up and adjust machines and equipment; recommend or execute personnel actions such as hiring and evaluation and promotion; and plan and develop new products and production processes.

zh.name: 生产运营工人一线主管
zh.summary: 直接监督并协调生产与操作人员的工作，如检验员、精密工人、机器调试与操作员、装配工、制作工以及工厂和系统操作员（不含团队负责人或作业组长）：执行安全与卫生规范；保存员工出勤与工时记录；检查物料与产品或设备以发现缺陷或故障；阅读并分析图表与工单与生产排程与其他记录与报告以确定生产需求并评估当期产量估算与产出；制定并确立工作排班与任务分配与生产顺序以达成生产目标；与其他主管商谈以协调部门内或部门间的运营与活动；向工人解释规格与图纸与工单与公司政策与程序；观察作业并监控仪表与刻度等指标以确保操作员符合生产或加工标准；指导并协调从事货物生产或加工的员工（如检验员与机器调试员与制作工）的活动；开展设备操作或作业与安全程序的员工培训或将培训分配给有经验的员工；评估员工绩效；与管理层或下属商谈以解决工人问题与投诉与申诉；依公司政策与设备与人力可用性与工作量确定标准与预算与生产目标与定额；使用标准公式计算人工与设备需求与生产规格；建议或实施激励员工与改进生产方法或设备性能或产品质量或效率的措施；维护工时与产量与成本等运营数据并编制生产结果的管理报告；申购材料与用品与设备零件或维修服务；设置并调整机器与设备；建议或执行招聘与评估与晋升等人事处理；规划并开发新产品与生产流程。

en.name: First-Line Supervisors of Retail Sales Workers
en.summary: Directly supervise and coordinate the activities of retail sales workers in an establishment or department; in addition to supervisory duties, may also take on management functions such as purchasing, budgeting, accounting, and personnel: provide customer service by greeting and assisting customers and responding to customer inquiries and complaints; direct and supervise employees engaged in sales, inventory-taking, reconciling cash receipts, or in performing services for customers; inspect merchandise to ensure that prices and displays are correct and that merchandise functions as advertised; monitor sales activities to ensure that customers receive satisfactory service and quality goods; instruct staff on how to handle difficult and complicated sales; assign employees to specific duties; keep records of purchases, sales, and requisitions; participate in the work of subordinates, such as cleaning and organizing shelves and displays and selling merchandise; formulate and prepare work schedules and keep records of employees' schedules and time cards; review inventory and sales records to prepare reports for management and budget departments; take inventory and reorder when inventory drops to a specified level; formulate and implement policies and goals and objectives and procedures for the department; examine products purchased for resale or received for storage to assess their condition; enforce safety and health and security rules; estimate consumer demand and determine the types and quantities of goods to be sold; confer with company management to develop methods and procedures to improve sales and expand markets and promote business; establish pricing policies for merchandise in accordance with profitability requirements; hire and train and evaluate personnel in sales or marketing establishments and promote or terminate employees as appropriate; plan and coordinate advertising campaigns and sales promotions and prepare merchandise displays and advertising copy; establish credit policies and operating procedures; and plan budgets and authorize payments and merchandise returns.

zh.name: 零售销售工人一线主管
zh.summary: 直接监督并协调机构或部门的零售销售工人的活动；除监督职责外，还可能承担采购、预算、会计与人事等管理职能：通过问候与协助顾客并回应顾客询问与投诉来提供客户服务；指导并监督从事销售、盘点、核对现金收入或为顾客提供服务的员工；检查商品以确保定价与陈列正确且功能与宣传相符；监控销售活动以确保顾客获得满意的服务与优质商品；指导员工处理困难与复杂的销售；把员工分配到具体职责；保存采购与销售与申购记录；参与下属的工作，如清洁与整理货架与陈列与销售商品；制定并准备工作排班并保存员工排班与工时卡记录；审阅库存与销售记录以为管理层与预算部门编制报告；盘点库存并在库存降至指定水平时补货；为部门制定并实施政策与目标与目的与程序；检查为转售采购或为存储收到的产品以评估其状况；执行安全与健康与安保规则；估算消费者需求并确定所售商品的种类与数量；与公司管理层商谈以制定提高销售与扩大市场与促进业务的方法与流程；根据盈利要求制定商品定价政策；招聘与培训与评估销售或营销机构的人员并在适当时晋升或解雇员工；规划并协调广告活动与销售促销并准备商品陈列与广告文案；制定信用政策与操作程序；规划预算并授权付款与商品退货。

en.name: Fish and game wardens
en.summary: Patrol assigned areas to prevent violations of fish and game laws and regulations; investigate reports of wildlife damaging crops or property; compile biological data. (US SOC/O*NET 33-3031.00, Fish and Game Wardens)

zh.name: 鱼类与野生动物管理员
zh.summary: 巡逻指定区域以防止违反渔猎法律法规；调查野生动物破坏农作物或财产的报告；汇编生物数据。（美国 SOC/O*NET 33-3031.00，Fish and Game Wardens）

en.name: Fitness and Wellness Coordinators
en.summary: Manage or coordinate fitness and wellness programs and services; manage and train staff such as wellness specialists, health educators, or fitness instructors. (U.S. O*NET-SOC 11-9179.01, Fitness and Wellness Coordinators; wages and employment use the SOC 11-9179 group scope.)

zh.name: 健身与健康协调员
zh.summary: 管理或协调健身与健康项目与服务；管理并培训健康专家、健康教育者或健身教练等员工。（美国 O*NET-SOC 11-9179.01，Fitness and Wellness Coordinators；工资与就业为 SOC 11-9179 组口径）

en.name: Fitness Trainers and Group Fitness Instructors
en.summary: Instruct or coach groups or individuals in exercise activities primarily for personal fitness; demonstrate techniques and form, observe participants, and explain corrective measures; develop and implement individualized exercise programs. (U.S. O*NET-SOC 39-9031.00, Exercise Trainers and Group Fitness Instructors)

zh.name: 健身训练师与团课教练
zh.summary: 指导或训练团体或个人进行以个人健身为主要目的的锻炼活动；示范技巧与姿势、观察参与者并说明纠正措施；制定并实施个性化锻炼方案。（美国 O*NET-SOC 39-9031.00，Exercise Trainers and Group Fitness Instructors）

en.name: Flight Attendants
en.summary: Flight attendants complete work involving the occupation’s subjects, processes, quality, and delivery; check specific tasks, training, qualifications, agreements, and authorization against original texts from the relevant locality and employer.

zh.name: 空乘人员
zh.summary: 空乘人员围绕本职业对象、流程、质量与交付完成工作；具体任务、训练、资格、协议和授权须按所在地与雇主原文核对。

en.name: Floral Designers
en.summary: Floral designers carry out work involving this occupation's objects, processes, quality, and delivery; specific tasks, training, qualifications, protocols, and authority must be checked against original local and employer documentation.

zh.name: 花艺设计师
zh.summary: 花艺设计师围绕本职业对象、流程、质量与交付完成工作；具体任务、训练、资格、协议和授权须按所在地与雇主原文核对。

en.name: Food and Tobacco Roasting, Baking, and Drying Machine Operators and Tenders
en.summary: Operate or tend food and tobacco roasting, baking, and drying equipment, monitor temperatures, times, and moisture under work orders and valid processes, and record batches, samples, and abnormalities. Perform actual operation, maintenance, and release according to training, procedures, and job authorization.

zh.name: 食品与烟草烘烤、烘焙与干燥设备操作与看护员
zh.summary: 操作或看护食品与烟草烘烤、烘焙和干燥设备，按工单及有效工艺监控温度、时间与水分，记录批次、取样及异常；实际操作、检修和放行按培训、规程与岗位授权开展。

en.name: Food Cooking Machine Operators and Tenders
en.summary: Operate or tend steam vats, fryers, pressure cookers, and kettles. Check ingredients against orders and recipes, observe gauges and products, and record steps, times, batches, and tests. Actual operation, maintenance, and release follow training, procedures, and job authorization.

zh.name: 食品烹煮设备操作与看护员
zh.summary: 操作或看护蒸煮罐、油炸锅、压力锅及锅釜等食品烹煮设备，按工单与配方核投料，观察仪表和产品，记录处理步骤、时间、批次及检测结果；实际操作、检修与放行按训练、规程和岗位授权开展。

en.name: Food Preparation Workers
en.summary: Food preparation workers carry out work involving this occupation's materials, processes, quality requirements, and deliverables. Specific duties, training, qualifications, agreements, and authorization must be checked against the original requirements of the location and employer.

zh.name: 食品制备人员
zh.summary: 食品制备人员围绕本职业对象、流程、质量与交付完成工作；具体任务、训练、资格、协议和授权须按所在地与雇主原文核对。

en.name: Food Science Technicians
en.summary: Food science technicians carry out work involving this occupation's materials, processes, quality requirements, and deliverables. Specific duties, training, qualifications, agreements, and authorization must be checked against the original requirements of the location and employer.

zh.name: 食品科学技术员
zh.summary: 食品科学技术员围绕本职业对象、流程、质量与交付完成工作；具体任务、训练、资格、协议和授权须按所在地与雇主原文核对。

en.name: Food Scientists and Technologists
en.summary: Food scientists and technologists carry out work involving this occupation's subjects, processes, quality requirements, and deliverables. Specific duties, training, qualifications, agreements, and authorization must be checked against the original requirements of the location and employer.

zh.name: 食品科学家与食品技术专家
zh.summary: 食品科学家与食品技术专家围绕本职业对象、流程、质量与交付完成工作；具体任务、训练、资格、协议和授权须按所在地与雇主原文核对。

en.name: Food Servers, Nonrestaurant
en.summary: Deliver food outside restaurants, including guest rooms, hospital rooms, residential care facilities, and vehicles: prepare and check orders, assist diners, collect and clean items, and record abnormalities. Role procedures define actual duties and response authority.

zh.name: 非餐厅食品服务员
zh.summary: 在客房、病房、居住照护机构或车辆等餐厅之外的场景送餐：按单备餐与核对、协助就餐、回收清洁并记录异常；实际任务与处置权限由岗位规程明确。

en.name: Food service managers
en.summary: Manages the daily activities of a food service establishment or department: organising schedules, purchasing and inventory, costs and personnel, service and food hygiene; also takes part in food preparation and service when needed. Actual decisions and licensing authority are verified against local regulations and position authorisation.

zh.name: 餐饮服务经理
zh.summary: 管理餐饮机构或部门的日常活动：组织排班、采购库存、成本与人员、服务与食品卫生；必要时也参与备餐和服务。实际决定与许可权限按当地法规及岗位授权核对。

en.name: Forensic science technicians
en.summary: Collect and analyse physical evidence in criminal cases, record the scene and examination process and write reports, and some staff give evidence in court within their field of expertise. The division between scene and laboratory positions and independent examination and sign-off authority must be verified against the locality and the institution.

zh.name: 法医科学技术员
zh.summary: 采集和分析刑事案件物证，记录现场及检验过程、撰写报告，部分人员在专长范围内出庭说明。现场与实验室岗位分工、独立检验和签发权限须按所在地与机构核对。

en.name: Forest and conservation technicians
en.summary: Forest And Conservation Technicians (O*NET-SOC 19-4071.00) provide technical assistance for the conservation of soil, water, forests and related natural resources: they may, under the direction of foresters, compile and organise data on the size, composition and condition of forest tracts, or train and lead forest workers in forest propagation and fire prevention and suppression, and assist conservation scientists in managing and improving rangelands and wildlife habitats. Official definition text: Provide technical assistance regarding the conservation of soil, water, forests, or related natural resources. May compile data pertaining to size, content, condition, and other characteristics of forest tracts under the direction of foresters, or train and lead forest workers in forest propagation and fire prevention and suppression. May assist conservation scientists in managing, improving, and protecting rangelands and wildlife habitats.

zh.name: 林业与保护技术员
zh.summary: 林业与保护技术员（O*NET-SOC 19-4071.00，Forest And Conservation Technicians）为土壤、水、森林及相关自然资源的保护提供技术协助：可能在林务人员指导下汇总与整理林分的面积、组成与状况等数据，或培训并带领林业工人开展林木繁育与火灾预防与扑救，并协助保护科学家管理与改善牧场与野生动物栖息地。官方定义原文：Provide technical assistance regarding the conservation of soil, water, forests, or related natural resources. May compile data pertaining to size, content, condition, and other characteristics of forest tracts under the direction of foresters, or train and lead forest workers in forest propagation and fire prevention and suppression. May assist conservation scientists in managing, improving, and protecting rangelands and wildlife habitats.

en.name: Forest Fire Inspectors and Prevention Specialists
en.summary: Forest fire inspectors look for hazards in forests, recommend prevention measures and may report fires or weather conditions. Some assignments include directing firefighters in the field. That does not make the inspector the overall incident commander or a building fire inspector.

zh.name: 森林防火检查与预防专员
zh.summary: 森林防火检查与预防专员排查林区火险、提出防控建议，并可能报告火情和气象。这个美国职业与中国大陆护林员的防火巡护有交集；设站检查、监督检查和火场指挥各有职责主体。

en.name: Foresters
en.summary: Foresters survey stands, estimate timber volume and use those findings to plan how forests are managed. Depending on the job, they may oversee contracts, replanting or habitat protection.

zh.name: 林务员
zh.summary: 林务员根据林地调查和蓄积估算制定森林经营方案，并跟进造林、抚育、采伐安排和合同。中国大陆可比较林草资源调查监测、林业调查规划和森林经营技术岗；实际分工和招聘条件以岗位为准。

en.name: Forestry and Conservation Science Teachers, Postsecondary
en.summary: College forestry and conservation science instructors teach courses, guide fieldwork and mentor students. Some roles focus on teaching; others also require research and publication. The job posting tells you which work the institution expects.

zh.name: 林业与保护科学教师（高等教育）
zh.summary: 高校林学和自然保护相关专业教师要把森林经营、森林保护或生态研究转化为课程、实习和学生指导。岗位可能以教学为主，也可能兼有研究。申请中国大陆岗位时，先区分招聘专业、教学科研分工和高校教师资格认定。

en.name: Forging Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
en.summary: Forging machine operators use presses or hammers to shape stock. A setup can involve fitting dies, running a trial piece, checking its dimensions and stopping when the result falls outside the work order. The U.S. occupation covers metal and plastic parts.

zh.name: 锻造工
zh.summary: 锻造工用锻压设备把毛坯压成规定形状。从读工单、换模和试做首件，到测量尺寸并报告异常，重点是让一批工件稳定达到要求。中国职业分类中的锻造工主要指金属毛坯加工；美国 O*NET 51-4022 的描述也覆盖塑料件。

en.name: Foundry Mold and Coremakers
en.summary: Foundry mold and coremakers form the molds or cores used to make metal castings. A mold defines the outside shape; a core can create a cavity inside the casting. Ask whether a vacancy centers on hand work, machine operation or both.

zh.name: 铸造造型工与制芯工
zh.summary: 铸造造型工做出铸件外形所需的铸型；制芯工做出形成内腔或其他内部特征的型芯。两类产出都交给后续铸造工序。大陆招聘可查“铸造造型工”“制芯工”，与美国 O*NET 51-4071 有任务交集。

en.name: Fraud Examiners, Investigators and Analysts
en.summary: Fraud examiners, investigators and analysts review unusual transactions, claims or other business records within their authority. They reconstruct timelines, preserve evidence that supports or weakens hypotheses, and refer unresolved issues to authorized decision-makers.

zh.name: 反欺诈审查、调查与分析人员
zh.summary: 反欺诈审查、调查与分析人员在岗位授权内核对异常交易、索赔或其他业务记录，梳理事件时间线，保留支持和削弱假设的材料，并把待查事项交给有权限的负责人。

en.name: Freight Forwarder
en.summary: Freight forwarders arrange shipments, coordinate carriers and keep documents and status updates moving between parties. Some specialize in international transport. U.S. pay and outlook on this page cover cargo and freight agents, a broader group.

zh.name: 国际货运代理操作员
zh.summary: 国际货运代理操作员在客户、承运人和其他服务方之间安排货运，跟进订舱、单证、费用和运输进度。工作重点是组织交接与异常沟通；美国统计用 Cargo and Freight Agents 上位组。

en.name: Fuel Cell Engineers
en.summary: Fuel cell engineers design, validate and improve stacks, components or systems for transportation, stationary or portable applications. Typical work includes planning tests, analyzing performance and durability data, and handing off design changes.

zh.name: 燃料电池工程师
zh.summary: 燃料电池工程师为交通、固定式或便携式应用设计、验证和改进电堆、部件或系统。实际工作包括拟定试验、分析性能和耐久性数据、交接工程变更。

en.name: Fundraiser
en.summary: Fundraisers help nonprofits or institutions secure support. They explain programs, contact donors or partners, organize campaign activities and track follow-up. A fundraising manager typically has responsibility for the overall program, budget or team.

zh.name: 公益筹款专员
zh.summary: 公益筹款专员为公益或教育等机构拓展捐赠来源、说明项目用途、跟进捐赠及记录反馈。工作可以偏机构合作、活动执行或捐赠人服务；公开募捐的组织资格、机构授权和具体岗位职责应分别核对。

en.name: Fundraising Manager
en.summary: Fundraising managers set campaign goals, plan staff and budgets, and coordinate donor communication with program and finance teams. Their work includes deciding what to pursue and how to report outcomes. Authorization to accept or commit funds depends on the organization.

zh.name: 筹款经理
zh.summary: 筹款经理安排年度筹资目标、项目组合、人员和捐赠人沟通计划，跟踪资金与活动成效，并与财务或项目团队核对用途和反馈。机构是否能公开募捐、谁能审批以及岗位管理幅度应分别核对。

en.name: Funeral Attendant
en.summary: Funeral attendants prepare rooms and equipment, guide visitors and assist with the service. Their work supports the arrangements made with families. Duties, schedules and contact with remains vary by employer.

zh.name: 殡仪现场服务员
zh.summary: 殡仪现场服务员准备场地及用品，按流程引导到场人员、协助礼仪并交接设备。大陆招聘中的殡仪服务、外勤接运可能是不同岗位，应分别核对体力、班次和现场职责。

en.name: Funeral Home Manager
en.summary: Funeral home managers coordinate staff, facilities, budgets and service procedures. They make sure individual services have the people and resources they need. Whether they can personally perform a regulated service depends on their role and jurisdiction.

zh.name: 殡仪机构运营经理
zh.summary: 殡仪机构运营经理安排人员、设施、预算和服务流程，协调前台、现场和后台。中国大陆殡仪馆与美国 funeral home 的组织及权限不一定对应；管理者是否可以执行特定专业工作，应另查当地规则和岗位。

en.name: Funeral Arranger
en.summary: Funeral arrangers work with families to plan individual services and coordinate the people, records and facilities involved. U.S. pay and outlook on this page use 39-4031, which also includes morticians and undertakers.

zh.name: 殡仪安排人员
zh.summary: 殡仪安排人员与家属确认服务选择、时间和流程，协调场地、人员与相关记录。页面对应美国 39-4031，包括遗体处理、承办和安排等不同分工；统计不是殡葬服务整个行业。大陆岗位名称及权限应逐岗核对。

en.name: Furniture Finishers
en.summary: Furniture finishers bring new, worn or damaged furniture to a specified color and finish. Tasks may include inspecting the substrate and existing finish, repairing defects, sanding, staining and checking against an approved sample.

zh.name: 家具表面修整工
zh.summary: 家具表面修整工根据指定颜色和表面效果，处理新制家具或修整磨损、受损家具。工作可能涉及检查基材和旧涂层、修补、打磨、着色和复核样板。

en.name: Gambling Cage Workers
en.summary: At licensed U.S. venues, cage workers maintain counter transaction records, count funds and reconcile daily totals against individual records. They retain original entries for review when totals differ.

zh.name: 博彩场所资金柜台人员
zh.summary: 在美国获许可的场所，资金柜台人员处理柜台资金记录，清点资金，并把日汇总与明细对账。发现差异时记录原值，并按授权交复核。

en.name: Gambling Change Persons and Booth Cashiers
en.summary: In licensed U.S. settings, these workers provide change services, maintain shift cashier records, check receipts or drawer counts and hand over the shift. Duties vary by booth and role authorization.

zh.name: 博彩场所兑换员与窗口收银员
zh.summary: 在美国获许可的场所，这类岗位负责兑换窗口服务、当班收银记录、票据或抽屉点数及交接。常见任务随窗口与岗位权限变化。

en.name: Gambling Dealers
en.summary: In licensed U.S. settings, dealers conduct table services, hand off records, and report disputes or irregularities within assigned authority.

zh.name: 博彩场所台面服务员
zh.summary: 在美国获许可的场所从事台面服务。工作包括按场所规则交接记录、报告争议或异常，并在分配权限内处理现场流程。

en.name: Gambling Managers
en.summary: In licensed U.S. settings, managers coordinate operations and staffing, supervise services and handle escalations. Approval authority depends on site rules and regulatory requirements.

zh.name: 博彩场所运营经理
zh.summary: 在美国获许可的场所组织运营、排班、监督服务和处理上报。实际审批范围取决于场所规则与监管要求。

en.name: Gambling Surveillance Officers and Gambling Investigators
en.summary: In licensed U.S. settings, surveillance officers observe irregular activity, document incidents and hand off evidence through authorized channels. Enforcement, external disclosure and disciplinary decisions follow separate authority.

zh.name: 博彩场所监控与调查员
zh.summary: 在美国持牌场所监看异常活动、记录事件并按授权交接证据。实际执法、证据外传或纪律决定由有相应权限的岗位处理。

en.name: Gas Compressor and Pumping Station Operator
en.summary: Gas compressor station operators monitor compressors, instruments and station conditions that support gas movement. They document readings and report deviations under site procedures. Gas processing operators focus more on treatment and product specifications.

zh.name: 天然气压缩与压气站运行操作员
zh.summary: 天然气压缩与压气站运行操作员监看压缩设备、仪表和运行记录，按现场程序处理和报告异常，支持气体输送或特定场站作业。它与处理厂对气体进行净化或分离的工作侧重不同。

en.name: Gas Plant Operator
en.summary: Gas plant operators monitor gas processing or distribution equipment, record changes and report deviations under plant procedures. Depending on the facility, the work may involve treatment, separation or coordinating product movement.

zh.name: 天然气处理厂操作员
zh.summary: 天然气处理厂操作员监控并记录气体处理或分配工艺，关注仪表、产品或运行状态，按现场规程巡检和交接。净化、分离及不同装置的职责由企业确定，不可用城镇燃气地方培训要求替代。

en.name: Gem and Diamond Workers
en.summary: Gem and diamond workers inspect, cut, polish or measure loose stones and record features and dimensions. Specialist grading, valuation and setting may be assigned separately.

zh.name: 宝石琢磨工
zh.summary: 中国大陆《职业分类大典》6-09-03-14 的宝石琢磨工以原石筛选、定型、剖切、琢磨和加工质量检查为主。与美国 O*NET 51-9071.06 的切磨任务部分对应。独立分级、估值和镶嵌需看具体分工与授权。

en.name: General and Operations Managers
en.summary: General and operations managers coordinate day-to-day operations across departments or locations. They review delivery figures with site supervisors, allocate staff and materials, and follow up on problems that cross team boundaries. The U.S. occupation 11-1021 excludes first-line supervisors. Chief executives typically have broader strategy and governance duties, with actual responsibilities set by the organization.

zh.name: 总经理和运营经理
zh.summary: 综合运营经理统筹多个部门或地点的日常运营，和各地主管核对交付量、安排人力与物料，并跟进跨团队异常。美国职业 11-1021 排除只负责一线班组的主管。企业主要负责人通常承担更广的战略和治理职责，实际分工看组织授权。

en.name: General Internal Medicine Physician
en.summary: General internists evaluate and manage a wide range of conditions in adults. They coordinate testing, referrals and follow-up. Some work in clinics, hospitals or both.

zh.name: 普通内科医师
zh.summary: 普通内科医师评估和管理多类成人内科疾病，协调检查、专科转诊和随访。门诊与住院职责随机构变化。

en.name: General Maintenance and Repair Worker
en.summary: General maintenance workers handle routine repairs and checks across buildings and equipment. They document problems and refer work that requires a specialist or separate authorization. The mix depends on the site.

zh.name: 综合维修工
zh.summary: 综合维修工处理建筑、场地及通用设备的维护问题，按工单巡检、记录、修复或转交专业人员。工作常覆盖多个设施系统，涉及专门或受监管的作业时应由获授权人员处理。

en.name: General Office Clerk
en.summary: General office clerks handle documents, enter records, respond to routine questions and support office operations. The mix varies by department.

zh.name: 办公室文员
zh.summary: 办公室文员处理文件、录入台账、接听问询并支持日常办公。部门和班组决定各项职责比例。

en.name: Genetic Counselor
en.summary: Genetic counselors gather family and medical information, explain genetic findings and limitations, and help people understand options within their scope. They may coordinate with clinicians and laboratories.

zh.name: 遗传咨询专业人员
zh.summary: 遗传咨询专业人员根据职责收集个人与家族史，向来访者解释遗传信息、结果及局限，并协助转介。美国职业与国内临床团队分工不能直接换算。

en.name: Geneticist
en.summary: Geneticists study inheritance, variation and gene function. They design studies and analyze evidence from sources such as model organisms, plants or human populations. Research is distinct from clinical genetics practice.

zh.name: 遗传学研究人员
zh.summary: 遗传学研究人员研究遗传、变异和基因功能，设计研究、分析数据并检验解释。方向可涉及植物、模式生物、人群等；研究角色不等同临床遗传诊疗。

en.name: Geodetic Surveyor
en.summary: Geodetic surveyors measure positions and elevations across large areas. Their work helps different surveys use a common reference. They may collect satellite observations or check control measurements; U.S. wage and outlook data cover all surveyors, not this specialty alone.

zh.name: 大地测量技术人员
zh.summary: 大地测量技术人员测定大范围区域内点位的位置和高程，建立或复核测量控制，为不同项目使用同一坐标基准提供依据。美国工资和就业是 Surveyors 上位职业统计；中国大陆单位测绘资质、个人资格和项目授权各自核对。

en.name: Geographer
en.summary: Geographers study why places differ and how people and the environment shape each other. They use field observations, maps and datasets to explain spatial patterns and test interpretations. GIS can support this work, but the main output is a defensible explanation.

zh.name: 地理学家
zh.summary: 地理学家用野外调查、地图、人口或环境数据解释地区为什么不同，以及自然过程和人类活动怎样相互影响。工作可以偏自然地理、人文地理或区域分析；GIS 是常用方法之一，研究问题和证据解释仍是核心。

en.name: GIS Technologist or Technician
en.summary: GIS technologists and technicians build or maintain spatial databases, check layers and produce maps or data services. Some jobs also involve scripting or supporting applications. The U.S. statistics on this page cover a broader computer occupation category.

zh.name: 地理信息系统（GIS）技术人员
zh.summary: GIS 技术人员维护空间数据库、检查坐标和属性，制作可供分析或发布使用的图层、地图或数据服务。岗位可能还包括脚本、系统维护或应用支持。美国 15-1299 统计覆盖其他计算机职业，不能当成 GIS 技术人员专属收入。

en.name: College Geography Teacher
en.summary: College geography teachers plan and teach geography courses, guide student work and may supervise field or lab activities. Some positions emphasize teaching; others combine it with research. The hiring institution determines the workload and qualifications.

zh.name: 高校地理教师
zh.summary: 高校地理教师设计课程、讲授地理学并指导实验、实习或学生项目。岗位可以偏教学，也可以兼顾研究与发表。大陆招聘应分别看研究方向、教学任务、学位要求和高校教师资格认定。

en.name: Geological Technician
en.summary: Geological technicians collect and check data for geologists or engineers. They may label cores, analyze drill cuttings, record borehole conditions or prepare samples for testing. This profile excludes the hydrologic technician occupation, though some projects involve water monitoring.

zh.name: 地质技术员（不含水文技术员）
zh.summary: 地质技术员协助地质人员或工程师采集和核对数据，工作可能包括岩芯编录、钻屑分析、记录孔内压力或温度、准备样品和交实验记录。职业分类不含水文技术员，但实际项目仍可能有地下水协作。

en.name: Geothermal Production Manager
en.summary: Geothermal production managers coordinate plant output, staffing, maintenance and responses to operating problems. Clarify whether a job runs an electricity generating plant or a direct-use heating operation. U.S. pay and outlook cover the broader industrial production managers occupation.

zh.name: 地热生产运行经理
zh.summary: 地热生产运行经理统筹场站产出、人员、设备维护和运行异常处置。美国职业资料指地热发电；大陆可比较水热供暖场站的运行管理任务。美国工资与就业数字是工业生产经理上位组。

en.name: Geothermal Technician
en.summary: Geothermal technicians monitor and maintain equipment, log readings and help find faults. Some work in geothermal power plants; others install or service heat pumps. U.S. wages and projections here cover a broader installation and repair occupation.

zh.name: 地热技术员
zh.summary: 地热技术员监看和维护地热系统设备，记录仪表、流量和运行异常。发电、地热供暖与地源热泵维护的现场任务各有不同。美国工资和就业是安装维护修理人员上位统计，不是地热专属。

en.name: Glass Blowers, Molders, Benders and Finishers
en.summary: Glass blowers and formers shape glass to a pattern by blowing, molding, bending or finishing it. They check dimensions and defects before handing off the work. U.S. wages and projections cover the broader parent occupation.

zh.name: 玻璃吹制与成型工
zh.summary: 玻璃吹制与成型工按图样塑造玻璃，工作可能包含吹制、模具成型、弯曲或修整。玻璃交付前要核对尺寸和缺陷记录。美国工资和就业采用上位职业数据。

en.name: Glaziers
en.summary: Glaziers check drawings and openings, install glass in windows, storefronts and other surfaces, and record fit, attachment and unresolved issues. Working at height or lifting glass depends on the site and authorization.

zh.name: 玻璃安装工
zh.summary: 玻璃安装工核对图纸和洞口，把玻璃安装在窗、店面或建筑内外表面，并记录接缝、固定与待核事项。高处或吊装由项目按条件和授权安排。

en.name: Government Property Inspectors and Investigators
en.summary: Government property inspectors and investigators examine records, contracts and site conditions for assets such as public housing or construction sites. They document discrepancies and evidence and refer inspection reports to authorized officials.

zh.name: 政府资产检查与调查人员
zh.summary: 政府资产检查与调查人员按授权核对公共住房、工地或其他政府资产的现场情况、合同及记录，整理差异和证据，形成检查报告并交有权限的负责人。

en.name: Graphic Designer
en.summary: Graphic designers organize visual information for audiences. They create layouts and visual systems for print or digital materials, explain design choices and prepare files for delivery.

zh.name: 平面设计师
zh.summary: 平面设计师用文字、图形、颜色和版式组织视觉信息，输出品牌、印刷或数字物料。实际工作还包括理解需求、比较方案和检查交付文件。

en.name: Hand Grinder and Polisher
en.summary: Hand grinders and polishers use hand tools or manually guided equipment to remove defects, smooth surfaces and check the finish. They can work with different materials. This role differs from setting up a production grinding machine.

zh.name: 手工打磨与抛光工
zh.summary: 手工打磨与抛光工用手持工具、磨料或手工方法修整工件，检查毛刺、划痕和表面质量。材料可能不只金属。它与磨床调机不同，岗位也可能偏去毛刺、修磨或抛光。

en.name: Grounds Maintenance Worker
en.summary: Grounds maintenance workers keep lawns and planted areas in usable condition across parks, campuses and other properties. They record issues and coordinate handoffs across the site. U.S. statistics here are for occupation 37-3011.

zh.name: 场地绿化养护工
zh.summary: 场地绿化养护工按片区维护公园、校园或单位的草坪、树木和公共绿地，发现破损或异常后记录并交接。这里的美国数据只采用 37-3011 的岗位口径。

en.name: Hand Laborers and Material Movers
en.summary: This guide compares hands-on roles in loading, moving, sorting and packing goods. Employers may separate or combine tasks. Physical demands, work schedules and equipment depend on the site. The U.S. figures in the main card cover only the hand freight and material moving component (53-7062).

zh.name: 人工物料搬运与装卸
zh.summary: 这个总览比较人工装卸、搬运、分拣和包装等一线任务。岗位可能按环节分开或合并，实际体力、班次和工具取决于雇主。顶部美国数字只显示 53-7062 人工货物及物料搬运分项，不能用于总览内的全部岗位。

en.name: Hazardous Materials Removal Workers
en.summary: Hazardous materials removal workers identify, remove, package or hand off hazardous materials on controlled projects. Duties depend on the material, site and training. Projects assign sampling, protective controls, transport and compliance responsibilities separately.

zh.name: 危险材料清除作业人员
zh.summary: 危险材料清除作业人员在受管控的项目中识别、移除、装包或交接危险材料。任务取决于材料、场地和岗位训练，项目还会区分样品、人员防护、运输与合规责任。

en.name: Health and Safety Engineer
en.summary: Health and safety engineers identify hazards in equipment, processes or workplaces and evaluate ways to reduce them. Roles may focus on product safety, facilities or system design. U.S. figures use 17-2111, excluding mining safety engineers and inspectors.

zh.name: 健康与安全工程师
zh.summary: 健康与安全工程师识别设备、流程和工作环境里的风险，提出预防措施并核对效果。岗位可以偏产品安全、生产现场或系统设计。美国数字采用 17-2111，不含矿山安全工程师及检查员。

en.name: Health and Safety Engineer, Except Mining Safety
en.summary: This U.S. occupation covers engineers who assess and control hazards outside the mining safety engineer and inspector category. Work may include evaluating equipment or product designs, reviewing incidents and testing controls. Training and authorization depend on the job and jurisdiction.

zh.name: 健康与安全工程师（不含矿山安全）
zh.summary: 这一美国职业口径覆盖非矿山的健康与安全工程设计和评估。工作可以是评估设备或产品的危险、核控制设计、查现场问题或支持改进验证。矿山安全另有职业分类；工作需要哪类资格或授权看具体行业和地区。

en.name: Health Education Specialists
en.summary: Health education specialists identify learning needs, design or review educational materials and activities, track reach and feedback, and coordinate programme improvements.

zh.name: 健康教育专员
zh.summary: 健康教育专员识别目标人群的学习需要，设计或审校健康教育材料与活动，记录触达、反馈和评估结果，协调项目改进。

en.name: Health Informatics Specialist
en.summary: Health informatics specialists connect clinical work with information systems. They may document requirements, test workflows or support staff adoption. U.S. wages and projections here cover computer systems analysts, a broader occupation.

zh.name: 医疗信息化专员
zh.summary: 医疗信息化专员把临床和运营需求转成系统流程、测试场景和培训材料，并跟踪问题和数据质量。可能涉及电子病历、护理信息或临床业务系统。美国工资就业来自计算机系统分析师上位组。

en.name: Health Information Technologist or Medical Registrar
en.summary: Health information technologists and medical registrars organize, check and maintain healthcare data. Some work on information systems or data quality; others maintain registries for a specific condition or service. Their duties vary by organization.

zh.name: 健康信息技术员与医疗登记员
zh.summary: 健康信息技术员与医疗登记员协助组织、核对和维护健康数据。部分岗位侧重信息系统或数据质量，另一些负责专门疾病或服务登记。大陆病案编码和信息管理岗位有相近任务，不能与美国分类直接互换。

en.name: Postsecondary Health Specialties Teachers
en.summary: Postsecondary health specialties teachers teach subjects such as medicine, pharmacy, public health, therapy, veterinary medicine and laboratory technology. Roles may include curriculum, grading, clinical supervision or research.

zh.name: 高校医学与健康专业教师
zh.summary: 高校医学与健康专业教师在高等教育中教授医学、药学、公共卫生、治疗专业、兽医或实验技术等课程。岗位可能兼有课程开发、评分、临床带教或科研。

en.name: Healthcare Social Workers
en.summary: Healthcare social workers identify practical needs, coordinate with teams, and document referrals and handoffs. Their work can include helping families navigate care and connecting patients with community support after discharge.

zh.name: 医疗社会工作者
zh.summary: 医疗社会工作者（医务社工）了解患者和家庭的实际困难，与团队协调服务资源并记录转介和交接。常见任务包括适应就医过程、出院后的社区衔接和服务条件核对。

en.name: Hearing Aid Specialists
en.summary: Hearing aid specialists identify listening needs, assess fitting conditions within their scope, select or adjust devices, document fittings and arrange follow-up.

zh.name: 助听器验配专员
zh.summary: 助听器验配人员了解听觉需求，按岗位权限评估适配条件，选择或调整助听设备，记录验配结果并安排复核或随访。

en.name: Heat Treating Equipment Operator
en.summary: Heat treating equipment operators set up or run furnaces and other heating systems to change material properties. They follow process instructions, document batch conditions and help check results. The job can cover different equipment and materials.

zh.name: 热处理设备操作工
zh.summary: 热处理设备操作工按工艺要求设置或运行加热设备，记录批次、时间、温度与异常，配合检查处理结果。常见工艺包括退火、淬火或回火，但不应在没有工艺文件和授权时自行改参数。

en.name: Electrician Helpers
en.summary: Electrician helpers stage tools, conduit and other materials, assist with positioning and handling as assigned, and report discrepancies in labels, counts or locations. Check local qualifications and site authorization for wiring, testing and energizing.

zh.name: 电工助手
zh.summary: 电工助手为电工准备工具、线管和其他物料，按分工协助定位、传递与清理，并报告标签、数量或位置差异。接线、测试和送电的责任按当地资格及现场授权核对。

en.name: Helpers—Extraction Workers
en.summary: Extraction helpers prepare and move materials, keep work areas orderly, observe equipment or work conditions, and record and report exceptions. Equipment operation, servicing and hazardous tasks have separate training and authorization requirements.

zh.name: 采掘作业助手
zh.summary: 采掘作业助手在班组分工内准备和搬运物料、整理作业区、观察设备或作业状态，并记录和报告异常。设备操作、检修与危险工序分别核培训和授权。

en.name: Installation, Maintenance and Repair Helper
en.summary: Installation, maintenance and repair helpers support technicians by preparing materials, supplying tools, cleaning work areas and tracking tasks. The work and level of supervision depend on the trade and employer.

zh.name: 安装维护维修助理
zh.summary: 安装维护维修助理按安排备料、传递工具、整理现场和记录进度，帮助安装或维修人员完成工单。能否操作设备、独立检修或签字，要按实际岗位授权确认。

en.name: Painting and Plastering Helpers
en.summary: Painting and plastering helpers stage and deliver materials and tools for painting, paperhanging, plastering or stucco crews. They check labels and counts, protect assigned surfaces and clean work areas. Ask the site lead about ventilation, protective controls, tools and work at height.

zh.name: 涂装与抹灰助手
zh.summary: 涂装与抹灰助手为涂装、裱糊、抹灰或灰泥施工班组准备和递送材料与工具，核对标签和数量，按分工保护作业面并清理。向现场负责人核对通风、防护、受限工具及登高任务。

en.name: Production Helpers
en.summary: Production helpers stage and supply materials or tools, clean assigned areas and record material lots and unresolved issues. Crews assign tasks according to the equipment, process and authorization.

zh.name: 生产助手
zh.summary: 生产助手按工单准备和递送材料或工具，清理指定区域，并记录物料批次与未决问题。班组会按设备、工序和授权划定任务。

en.name: High School Teacher
en.summary: High school teachers plan and teach subject courses, assess student learning and provide feedback. This U.S. profile excludes special education and career or technical education teachers. Requirements vary by school and state.

zh.name: 高中教师
zh.summary: 高中教师按学科设计课程、组织教学、评估学习并给学生反馈，还会与同事和家长沟通。美国 25-2031 不含特殊教育及职业技术教育；大陆资格和聘任按学段、学科及公告核对。

en.name: Highway Maintenance Worker
en.summary: Highway maintenance workers inspect and maintain roads and roadside features. Duties can include cleaning, minor repairs, drainage work and reporting hazards to a supervisor. Assignments vary by crew and season.

zh.name: 公路养护工
zh.summary: 公路养护工巡查路面和附属设施，按安排参与清理、小修和排水维护，记录异常并向负责人报告。岗位可能分日常养护、应急支持和专门设施维护。

en.name: Histology Technician
en.summary: Histology technicians prepare tissue slides and record specimen handling under laboratory procedures. They may cut sections, stain slides and check preparation quality. Slide preparation supports later review; it does not itself establish a diagnosis.

zh.name: 组织学技术员
zh.summary: 组织学技术员按实验室规程处理组织样本，完成切片、染色及交接记录，并检查制片质量。其工作为后续观察或诊断提供材料，不代替病理医师作诊断。美国就业和工资的统计范围需按本页标签阅读。

en.name: Historian
en.summary: Historians investigate questions about the past using archives, published records, interviews or other evidence. They check where sources came from and explain what the evidence can and cannot support. Their work may appear in reports, publications or exhibits.

zh.name: 历史研究人员
zh.summary: 历史研究人员提出历史问题，收集并核对档案、文献、口述资料等证据，解释来源、背景和不确定性。产出可能是研究报告、文章、展陈解读或史料整理；高校课堂教学属于不同工作职责。

en.name: Histotechnologist
en.summary: Histotechnologists prepare and assess tissue slides and may troubleshoot staining or support the evaluation of laboratory methods. Duties can overlap with histology technicians. The authority to make a diagnosis is separate.

zh.name: 组织学技师
zh.summary: 组织学技师制备、染色并检查组织切片，还可能分析制片异常、开展特殊染色、维护记录或帮助验证方法。与组织学技术员的实际分工因实验室而异；制片质量判断不等于病理诊断。

en.name: Hoist and Winch Operators
en.summary: Hoist and winch operators lift or pull loads with powered cable equipment. They watch gauges and signals, assist with loading and unloading, and record equipment status and unresolved exceptions under site procedures. The U.S. O*NET occupation 53-7041.00 centers on powered cable lifting and pulling.

zh.name: 起重与卷扬设备操作工
zh.summary: 起重与卷扬设备操作工用动力绳索设备提升或牵引载荷。他们观察仪表和信号，配合装卸，并按现场分工记录设备状态及未决异常。美国 O*NET 53-7041.00 以动力绳索提升和牵引任务为核心。

en.name: Home Appliance Repairer
en.summary: Home appliance repairers respond to problems with household equipment such as washers and refrigerators. They gather information, diagnose faults, repair or replace parts and explain the outcome to the customer.

zh.name: 家用电器维修工
zh.summary: 家用电器维修工围绕单台洗衣机、冰箱等家电处理报修、判断故障、维修或更换部件，并向客户交接。工作地点可能是服务网点，也可能是客户家中。

en.name: Home Health Aides
en.summary: Home health aides help with daily activities under a written care plan, record observations, and report changes to the responsible team. Permitted health-related tasks depend on instructions, training and local rules.

zh.name: 家庭健康助理
zh.summary: 居家健康照护助理按书面照护安排协助日常活动，观察并记录变化，把异常交给负责人员。可执行的健康相关任务取决于指示、培训及所在地要求。

en.name: Hospitalist
en.summary: Hospitalists focus on hospitalized patients. They coordinate with nurses, specialists and discharge teams and hand over information as patients move between settings.

zh.name: 住院诊疗专责医师
zh.summary: 美国 Hospitalist 主要承担住院患者的诊疗协调，与护理、专科及出院团队合作。名称不直接等于国内住院医师培训或职级。

en.name: Hotel Front Desk Clerk
en.summary: Hotel front desk clerks handle reservations, arrivals, departures and guest requests. They coordinate with other departments and hand unresolved issues to the next shift. Schedules and transaction authority vary by property.

zh.name: 酒店前台接待员
zh.summary: 酒店前台接待员处理预订、入住退房、问询和交接，按酒店流程协调房务、工程等部门。前台岗位的权限、夜班安排和收款职责因单位而异。

en.name: Human Factors Engineer or Ergonomist
en.summary: Human factors engineers and ergonomists study how people interact with equipment, interfaces and work environments. They test changes that may improve usability, safety or comfort. U.S. pay and outlook use the broader industrial engineer occupation.

zh.name: 人因工程师与工效学专家
zh.summary: 人因工程师评估人怎样使用设备、界面、工具或工作空间，并提出可测试的设计调整。项目可以关注操作错误、舒适性、可达性或工作负荷。美国工资就业是工业工程师上位组，不是人因岗位单列。

en.name: Human Resources Assistant, Except Payroll and Timekeeping
en.summary: HR assistants verify and maintain personnel records and help with recruitment and onboarding. The U.S. classification on this page excludes jobs primarily responsible for payroll or timekeeping; it can still include recording information that supports those teams.

zh.name: 人力资源助理（非薪资与工时核算）
zh.summary: 人力资源助理核对入职材料、更新人事记录并协助安排招聘和员工流程。这里对应美国非薪资与工时核算助理；大陆人事助理、人事行政和招聘助理的职责可能交叉，应以实际岗位任务为准。

en.name: Human Resources Manager
en.summary: HR managers plan and coordinate an organization’s people operations. They may lead an HR team, work with department leaders on staffing and decide which policy or employee issues need further review. Approval authority varies by organization.

zh.name: 人力资源经理
zh.summary: 人力资源经理统筹人员计划、招聘与员工项目，并协调业务负责人处理资源或制度问题。典型交付包括人员方案、流程安排和需要升级的决策；具体预算、招聘和劳动关系处置权限由单位规定。

en.name: Hydroelectric Plant Technician
en.summary: Hydroelectric plant technicians inspect generators and related equipment, record defects and support operations or maintenance. Some roles focus on mechanical, electrical or controls work. The U.S. figures here cover the broader power plant operators occupation.

zh.name: 水电站运维技术员
zh.summary: 水电站运维技术员巡查水轮发电机组及附属设备、记录异常，并在授权范围内协助运行或检修。岗位可能偏运行、机械、电气或仪控；美国数据采用发电厂操作员上位组。

en.name: Hydroelectric Production Manager
en.summary: Hydroelectric production managers coordinate plant operations, staff and maintenance. Work can involve dispatch communication and coordination with water users and other stakeholders. U.S. pay and outlook use the broader industrial production managers occupation.

zh.name: 水电生产运行经理
zh.summary: 水电生产运行经理统筹机组运行、班组和维护计划，并与调度、安全及检修团队协作。机组运行协调与水库调度权限要分别核对。美国薪资就业按工业生产经理上位职业统计。

en.name: Hydrologist
en.summary: Hydrologists study how water moves through land and underground systems. They analyze measurements and test models to explain floods, water availability or groundwater changes. Study design and interpretation distinguish the role from routine data collection.

zh.name: 水文学家
zh.summary: 水文学家研究水在地表和地下如何分布、流动和变化，用监测数据和模型解释洪水、水资源或地下水问题。模型结论要记录假设、误差与适用范围；研究分析、现场测报和调度指令是不同职责。

en.name: Industrial Designer
en.summary: Industrial designers develop concepts for physical products. They consider how people use the product, how it looks and what can be manufactured. They use sketches, models and prototypes to explore options with engineers and producers.

zh.name: 工业设计师
zh.summary: 工业设计师构思实体产品，研究使用场景和尺寸、材料、成本等约束，制作草图和原型，与工程及制造团队验证方案。产品视觉表达只是交付的一部分。

en.name: Industrial Ecologists
en.summary: Industrial ecologists study material and energy use, waste and releases across industrial activities and how processes and sites connect. Deliverables may include inventories, scope and assumptions, comparisons and recommendations.

zh.name: 工业生态学工作者
zh.summary: 工业生态学工作者研究工业活动如何使用材料和能源、产生废物或排放，以及不同过程和场所之间的联系。常见交付包括物质与能源清单、边界与假设说明、结果对照和改进建议。

en.name: Industrial Engineering Technician
en.summary: Industrial engineering technicians collect measurements, document production conditions and support process trials. Their records help engineers test whether a layout or process works. Work may include time studies or production documentation.

zh.name: 工业工程技术员
zh.summary: 工业工程技术员按研究计划或工艺要求记录节拍、设备状态和现场数据，协助测试或整理标准作业。岗位责任可能包括取样、核对记录及异常上报；是否能批准变更，应以组织授权为准。

en.name: Industrial Engineer
en.summary: Industrial engineers design and evaluate systems that combine people, equipment, materials and information. They may improve production flow, quality, logistics or cost. A useful recommendation balances throughput with safety and quality.

zh.name: 工业工程师
zh.summary: 工业工程师研究人员、设备、物料和信息怎样一起工作，设计并验证布局、产能、质量或成本方案。岗位可偏制造、流程改进或运营；优化不能只看节拍，还要核质量、安全和执行约束。

en.name: Industrial Machinery Mechanic
en.summary: Industrial machinery mechanics diagnose faults in production equipment, repair or replace components and help verify that the machine can return to service. They coordinate with operators, maintenance planners and technical specialists.

zh.name: 工业设备维修技工
zh.summary: 工业设备维修技工诊断生产机械的异常，按工单和权限维修或更换部件，并配合检查设备能否安全恢复运行。岗位可能要与操作、工艺、质量和专业维修人员交接。

en.name: Industrial-Organizational Psychologists
en.summary: Industrial-organizational psychologists apply psychology and research methods to workplace problems. They may design job analyses, selection procedures, training or organizational surveys and explain where the evidence applies.

zh.name: 工业与组织心理学工作者
zh.summary: 工业与组织心理学工作者用心理学和研究方法分析工作场所问题，设计岗位分析、人员选拔、培训或组织调查，并说明证据适用范围。

en.name: Industrial Production Manager
en.summary: Industrial production managers coordinate manufacturing schedules, staffing and resources. They track quality, output, cost and safety and resolve issues that affect delivery. Authority varies by plant.

zh.name: 制造生产经理
zh.summary: 制造生产经理组织车间或工厂的生产计划、班组和资源，跟踪质量、产量、成本与安全，并协调异常和交付。工厂大小和汇报关系会改变岗位权限。

en.name: Industrial Truck or Forklift Operator
en.summary: Industrial truck operators move and stack materials with authorized equipment in warehouses, plants or yards. They coordinate with people working nearby and document handoffs. Training and authorization depend on the equipment and site.

zh.name: 叉车及工业车辆操作员
zh.summary: 叉车及工业车辆操作员在仓库、工厂或场站用获准车辆装卸、转运及堆码货物。工作还涉及确认货物、通道和交接记录。具体设备、培训与授权须按地区和用工场所核对。

en.name: Lawyers
en.summary: Lawyers organize facts, check evidence and legal sources, advise clients, draft documents, and represent clients within the scope of their authority.

zh.name: 律师
zh.summary: 律师根据委托事项梳理事实、核对证据和法律来源，提供法律意见、起草文件，或在相应权限内代理当事人。

en.name: Locomotive Engineers
en.summary: Locomotive engineers drive locomotives in rail service. They check operating information, signals and equipment condition and report exceptions to dispatchers, crew and maintenance staff under railroad procedures.

zh.name: 铁路机车司机
zh.summary: 铁路机车司机在铁路运输中驾驶机车，核对运行计划、信号和设备状态，按规程与调度、乘务及检修人员交接异常。

en.name: Logistician
en.summary: Logisticians coordinate the flow of products across procurement, inventory, transportation and delivery. A typical decision is how to get a delayed shipment back on track while keeping the customer and carrier informed.

zh.name: 物流专员（物流师）
zh.summary: 物流专员把采购、库存、运输和交付衔接起来：跟踪哪些订单会延误，协调仓库和承运商，并确认异常由谁处理。中国就业网职业画像列出物流专员、物流助理等招聘名称；看是否要对运输与交付过程负责，比看职位名称更有用。

en.name: Logistics Analyst
en.summary: Logistics analysts use shipment, inventory and cost records to find where delivery performance is slipping and recommend changes. They may also track shipments or work with carriers. U.S. wage and outlook figures here cover the broader Logisticians occupation.

zh.name: 物流分析师
zh.summary: 物流分析师用订单、库存和运输记录找出延误、缺货或费用异常，再提出可验证的改进建议。常见交付是指标说明、问题清单和分析报告。大陆可按物流数据分析、仓储分析和供应链分析等任务找岗位，不能只看名称。

en.name: Market Research Analyst
en.summary: Market research analysts frame research questions, collect customer or competitor evidence, and explain what the data supports. The U.S. figures use occupation 13-1161, which also covers marketing specialists.

zh.name: 市场研究分析师
zh.summary: 市场研究分析师明确市场问题，收集用户、竞品或行业资料，分析数据并写出证据和限制。这里的美国统计采用市场研究与营销专员合并职业行 13-1161。

en.name: Massage Therapists
en.summary: U.S. massage therapists work with soft tissue within the agreed scope, confirm goals and consent, prepare the space, and document the session and issues requiring referral.

zh.name: 按摩治疗师
zh.summary: 中国大陆保健按摩师等服务岗位与美国按摩治疗师部分相邻，适用范围和许可要求不同。接待时要核对预约和服务同意，记录反馈并按场馆流程交接。

en.name: Mechanical Engineer
en.summary: Mechanical engineers turn functional and manufacturing requirements into designs, analyses and test plans. They compare alternatives, develop prototypes and coordinate with drafting, manufacturing and quality teams.

zh.name: 机械工程师
zh.summary: 机械工程师把功能、载荷、制造和维护要求转化为机械方案，做分析、选材、试制与验证，并与制图、工艺和质量团队交接。不同产业的产品与签审责任不同。

en.name: Media Programming Directors
en.summary: Media programming directors coordinate program schedules and production staff. They check airtimes, versions and content awaiting review. U.S. wage and employment figures cover the broader producers and directors group.

zh.name: 媒体节目编排主管
zh.summary: 媒体节目编排主管协调广播、电视等节目的排期与制作人员，核对播出时间、版本和内容待审事项。美国工资和就业数据采用制片人与导演上位职业。

en.name: Medical Equipment Repairer
en.summary: Medical equipment repairers install, inspect, maintain and repair medical equipment. They document service and coordinate verification before return to use. Clinical operation is a separate assignment.

zh.name: 医疗设备维修技师
zh.summary: 医疗设备维修技师安装、检查、维护和维修医用设备，记录异常和服务结果，并按机构授权安排验证及恢复使用。维修工作与临床操作分开。

en.name: Medical Records Specialists
en.summary: Medical records specialists check record ownership, organize and classify or code information under applicable rules, and refer missing documentation or mismatched records to the responsible person.

zh.name: 病案与卫生信息记录专员
zh.summary: 中国大陆《职业分类大典》中的病案信息技师（2-05-07-14）负责病案管理、统计和编码。病案整理和编码与美国 29-2072.00 的职责部分对应。实际工作先核对归属，再按规则分类编码，遇到缺项交给相应人员核实。

en.name: Mining and Geological Engineers
en.summary: Mining and Geological Engineers (O*NET 17-2151.00) conduct subsurface surveys to assess land and mining development sites, select and plan safe, economical, environmentally sound extraction methods and facilities, inspect unsafe conditions, and implement mine safety programs.

zh.name: 采矿与地质工程师
zh.summary: 采矿与地质工程师（O*NET 17-2151.00）进行地下勘测以评估土地与矿区开发场地，选择并规划安全、经济、环保的采掘方法与设施，检查不安全条件并实施矿山安全计划。

en.name: Mining and Geological Engineers, Including Mining Safety Engineers
en.summary: Mining and Geological Engineers, Including Mining Safety Engineers (O*NET 17-2151.00) conduct subsurface surveys to assess land and mining development sites, select and plan safe, economical, environmentally sound extraction methods and facilities, inspect unsafe conditions, and implement mine safety programs.

zh.name: 采矿与地质工程师（含矿山安全工程师）
zh.summary: 采矿与地质工程师（含矿山安全工程师，O*NET 17-2151.00）进行地下勘测以评估土地与矿区开发场地，选择并规划安全、经济、环保的采掘方法与设施，检查不安全条件并实施矿山安全计划。

en.name: Mobile heavy equipment mechanics
en.summary: Mobile heavy equipment mechanics (O*NET 49-3042.00) diagnose, adjust, repair, or overhaul mobile mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic equipment used in construction, logging, and mining, such as cranes, bulldozers, graders, and conveyors.

zh.name: 移动重型设备机械师
zh.summary: 移动重型设备机械师（O*NET 49-3042.00）诊断、调整、修理或大修用于建筑、伐木与采矿的移动式机械、液压与气动设备，如起重机、推土机、平地机与输送机。

en.name: Wood modelmakers
en.summary: Wood modelmakers (O*NET 51-7031.00, Model Makers, Wood) make full-size or scale precision wooden product models, patterns, templates, and fixtures according to blueprints, drawings, or written specifications, including wood jig builders and loft workers. Excludes metal and plastic modelmakers, wood patternmakers, carpenters, wooden furniture making, and mass-production woodworking machine operation.

zh.name: 木模工
zh.summary: 木模工（O*NET 51-7031.00，Model Makers, Wood）按蓝图、图纸或书面规格制作产品的全尺寸或比例木质精密模型、图案、模板与夹具，含木夹具制造工与放样工；职业范围不含金属与塑料模型制作工、木模图案师、木工（木匠）、木制家具制造与量产木工机械操作。

en.name: Molecular and cellular biologists
en.summary: Molecular and cellular biologists (O*NET-SOC 19-1029.02, Molecular and Cellular Biologists) study cell molecules and organelles to understand cell function and organization; the work is organized around designing and executing molecular or cellular experiments, completing laboratory procedures such as sequencing and cloning according to protocols, organizing and analyzing experimental data and interpreting results, and writing reports and grant applications.

zh.name: 分子与细胞生物学家
zh.summary: 分子与细胞生物学家（O*NET-SOC 19-1029.02，Molecular and Cellular Biologists）研究细胞分子与细胞器，以理解细胞功能与组织；工作以设计与执行分子或细胞实验、按规程完成测序与克隆等实验室程序、整理与分析实验数据并解释结果、撰写报告与经费申请为主线。

en.name: Morticians, Undertakers, and Funeral Arrangers
en.summary: Morticians, undertakers, and funeral arrangers (O*NET-SOC 39-4031.00) arrange and direct individual funeral services: interview families or other authorized people to confirm details; obtain information for legal documents such as death certificates and burial permits; coordinate transportation, embalming, and care of remains; contact cemeteries and clergy officiating ceremonies; arrange pallbearers and transportation for mourners; and maintain financial records and daily funeral home operations.

zh.name: 殡葬师、殡仪承办人、殡葬安排员
zh.summary: 殡葬师、殡仪承办人、殡葬安排员（O*NET-SOC 39-4031.00）安排并主持个人殡葬服务：与家属或其他授权人员面谈确认细节、办理死亡证明与安葬许可等法律文件所需信息、协调遗体接运与防腐照料、联系墓地与主持仪式的神职人员、安排扶柩人与哀悼者运输，并维护财务记录与殡仪馆日常运营。

en.name: Motorboat Mechanics and Service Technicians
en.summary: Motorboat mechanics and service technicians (O*NET-SOC 49-3051.00) repair and adjust electrical and mechanical equipment on boats with inboard or inboard-outboard engines: start engines and listen for abnormal sounds and vibration; replace oil and filters on schedule; disassemble, inspect, and replace components such as gears and piston rings; adjust carburetors and ignition timing; inspect and repair propellers and drive shafts; repair generators and wiring; install engines in boats and test operation on waterways; and record inspection and test results.

zh.name: 摩托艇机械师与服务技师
zh.summary: 摩托艇机械师与服务技师（O*NET-SOC 49-3051.00）修理并调整舷内机或舷内外机船的电气与机械设备：启动发动机并监听异响与振动、按周期更换机油与滤芯、拆解检查与更换齿轮与活塞环等部件、调整化油器与点火正时、检查修复螺旋桨与传动轴、检修发电机与线路，并把发动机装船后在水道做运行测试，同时记录检查与测试结果。

en.name: Motorcycle Mechanics
en.summary: Motorcycle Mechanics (O*NET-SOC 49-3052.00) diagnose, adjust, repair, or overhaul motorcycles, scooters, mopeds, dirt bikes, and similar motorized vehicles. Work centers on fault diagnosis and disassembly inspection, parts replacement and assembly calibration, chassis and transmission system repair, test-ride verification, and delivery records.

zh.name: 摩托车机械师
zh.summary: 摩托车机械师（O*NET-SOC 49-3052.00，Motorcycle Mechanics）诊断、调整、修理或大修摩托车、踏板车、轻便摩托、越野摩托与类似机动车辆；工作以故障诊断与拆检、部件更换与装配调校、底盘与传动系统维修、试车验证与交付记录为主线。

en.name: Special Effects Artists and Animators
en.summary: Special Effects Artists and Animators (O*NET-SOC 27-1014.00) use film, video, computers, or other electronic media to create animation and visual effects for products such as computer games, films, music videos, and advertisements. Work centers on storyboards and shot breakdown, key poses and motion curves, lighting, color, materials and compositing interfaces, continuity review, and version delivery. This page uses official sources only to explain occupational scope, tasks, work context, and statistical definitions.

zh.name: 特效艺术家与动画师
zh.summary: 特效艺术家与动画师（O*NET-SOC 27-1014.00，Special Effects Artists and Animators）使用电影、视频、计算机或其他电子媒介制作动画与视觉效果，服务于电子游戏、电影、音乐视频与广告等产品；工作以故事板与镜头分解、关键姿势与运动曲线、光色材质与合成接口、连续性复核与版本交付为主线。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、工作情境与统计口径。

en.name: Museum Technicians and Conservators
en.summary: Museum technicians and conservators (O*NET-SOC 25-4013.00) prepare and conserve museum objects for preservation, research, and exhibition: determine whether objects need conservation and select the safest and most effective methods; clean and consolidate materials such as paper, textiles, wood, metal, glass, ceramics, and furniture; document condition, treatment plans, and methods; install and arrange objects for exhibitions; and maintain collection databases. This page uses official sources only to explain occupational scope, tasks, preparation requirements, and statistical definitions.

zh.name: 博物馆技术员与文物修复师
zh.summary: 博物馆技术员与文物修复师（O*NET-SOC 25-4013.00）为博物馆藏品做保存、研究与展出前的准备与修复：判断物件是否需要修复并选择最安全有效的方法，清洁与加固纸张、纺织品、木、金属、玻璃、陶与家具等材料，记录状况、处理方案与所用方法，为展览安装布置文物并维护藏品数据库。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、准备要求与统计口径。

en.name: Music Therapists
en.summary: Music therapists assess needs, set goals, conduct music-based sessions, document progress, and coordinate with the care team. Training, credentials, and facility authorization must be checked separately.

zh.name: 音乐治疗师
zh.summary: 音乐治疗师按职责评估需求、制定目标、开展音乐活动、记录进展并与团队交接。临床训练、资格和机构授权分别核。

en.name: Musical Instrument Repairers and Tuners
en.summary: Musical Instrument Repairers and Tuners (O*NET 49-9063.00) repair percussion, stringed, reed, and wind instruments and may specialize in an area such as piano tuning. They inspect and assess instrument condition, disassemble and replace parts, adjust string tension and tuning, repair wood or metal damage, and accurately document repairs and handover. This page uses only official sources to explain occupational scope, tasks, preparation requirements, Chinese and U.S. statistical scopes, and authorization boundaries.

zh.name: 乐器维修工
zh.summary: 乐器维修工（O*NET 49-9063.00）修理打击、弦、簧片与管乐器，可专精某一领域（如钢琴调音）：检查并评估乐器状态、拆装与更换部件、调整弦张力与音准、修复木料或金属损伤，并如实记录维修与交付。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、准备要求、中美统计口径与授权边界。

en.name: Musicians and Singers
en.summary: Musicians and Singers (O*NET 27-2042.00) play one or more instruments or sing in stage, broadcast, film/television, or recorded performances. They practice and rehearse, play from notation or memory, audition and record, adapt and improvise, and collaborate with agents or managers. This page uses only official sources to explain occupational scope, tasks, preparation requirements, Chinese and U.S. statistical scopes, and authorization boundaries.

zh.name: 音乐家与歌手
zh.summary: 音乐家与歌手（O*NET 27-2042.00）演奏一种或多种乐器或演唱，在舞台、广播、影视或录音中演出：练习与排练、按谱或凭记忆演奏、试演与录制、改编与即兴，并与经纪人或管理者协作。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、准备要求、中美统计口径与授权边界。

en.name: Nannies
en.summary: Nannies (O*NET 39-9011.01) care for children in private households, supporting parents in meeting children's physical, emotional, intellectual, and social needs. They arrange meals and routines, organize games and outings, help with homework, support habit formation and safety, and regularly communicate and hand over records to parents. This page uses only official sources to explain occupational scope, tasks, preparation requirements, Chinese and U.S. statistical scopes, and authorization boundaries.

zh.name: 保姆
zh.summary: 保姆（O*NET 39-9011.01）在私人家庭中照护儿童，支持家长满足儿童的身体、情感、智力与社会需要：安排膳食与作息、组织游戏与外出、辅导作业、协助习惯养成与安全防护，并与家长定期沟通与交接记录。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、准备要求、中美统计口径与授权边界。

en.name: Nanosystems engineers
en.summary: Nanosystems engineers (O*NET 17-2199.09) design, develop, or supervise the production of materials, devices, and systems with unique molecular or macromolecular composition, applying nanoscale physics and electrical, chemical, or biological engineering principles; the work centers on design planning, synthesis and characterization, testing and validation, documentation and review, and coordination with suppliers and technicians. This page uses only official sources to explain the occupation scope, tasks, preparation requirements, Chinese and United States statistical scopes, and authorization boundaries.

zh.name: 纳米系统工程师
zh.summary: 纳米系统工程师（O*NET 17-2199.09）设计、开发或监督具有独特分子或大分子组成的材料、器件与系统的生产，应用纳米尺度物理以及电气、化学或生物工程原理；工作围绕设计规划、合成与表征、测试验证、文档与评审、供应商与技术员协调展开。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、准备要求、中美统计口径与授权边界。

en.name: Natural sciences managers
en.summary: Natural sciences managers (O*NET 11-9121.00) plan, direct, or coordinate activities and research and development work in fields such as life sciences, physical sciences, mathematics, and statistics: setting objectives and budgets, organizing research projects, and managing personnel and compliance requirements. This page uses only official sources to explain the occupation scope, tasks, preparation requirements, Chinese and United States statistical scopes, and authorization boundaries.

zh.name: 自然科学领域经理
zh.summary: 自然科学领域经理（O*NET 11-9121.00）规划、指导或协调生命科学、物理科学、数学、统计学等领域的活动及其研发工作：制定目标与预算、组织研究项目、管理人员与合规要求。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、准备要求、中美统计口径与授权边界。

en.name: Naturopathic physicians
en.summary: Naturopathic physicians (O*NET 29-1299.01) diagnose, treat, and help prevent disease using a practice system based on the individual's natural healing ability: collecting history and medication information, examining and assessing within the license and institutional authorization scope, explaining evidence and options, recording plans and monitoring responses, and referring when red flags or out-of-scope problems appear. This page uses only official sources to explain the occupation scope, tasks, preparation requirements, Chinese and United States statistical scopes, and authorization boundaries.

zh.name: 自然疗法医师
zh.summary: 自然疗法医师（O*NET 29-1299.01）使用基于个体自然恢复能力的实践体系诊断、治疗并帮助预防疾病：采集病史与用药信息、在执照与机构授权范围内检查与评估、解释证据与选择、记录计划并监测反应，并在出现红旗或范围外问题时转诊。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、准备要求、中美统计口径与授权边界。

en.name: Network and computer systems administrators
en.summary: Network and computer systems administrators (O*NET 15-1244.00) install, configure, and maintain an organization's local area networks, wide area networks, data communication networks, operating systems, and physical and virtual servers, monitor the integrity and availability of systems and scheduled tasks (including backups), analyze network and server resource usage and control user access, and may also assist with network modeling, analysis, and planning coordination. This page uses only official sources to explain the occupation scope, tasks, preparation requirements, Chinese and United States statistical scopes, and authorization boundaries.

zh.name: 网络与计算机系统管理员
zh.summary: 网络与计算机系统管理员（O*NET 15-1244.00）安装、配置并维护组织的局域网、广域网、数据通信网络、操作系统与物理／虚拟服务器，监控系统与计划任务（含备份）的完整性和可用性，分析网络与服务器资源占用并控制用户访问，还可能协助网络建模、分析与规划协调。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、准备要求、中美统计口径与授权边界。

en.name: Neurodiagnostic technologists
en.summary: Neurodiagnostic technologists (O*NET-SOC 29-2099.01) perform neuroelectrodiagnostic (END) examinations such as EEG, evoked potentials, polysomnography, and electronystagmography, and may conduct nerve conduction studies: collecting history and examination information, measuring and placing electrodes, recording and monitoring the patient, identifying artifacts, and organizing technical data and submitting a summary report to the physician. This page uses only official sources to explain the occupation scope, tasks, preparation requirements, Chinese and United States statistical scopes, and authorization boundaries.

zh.name: 神经诊断技师
zh.summary: 神经诊断技师（O*NET-SOC 29-2099.01）执行脑电图、诱发电位、多导睡眠图与眼震电图等神经电诊断（END）检查，可能实施神经传导研究：采集病史与检查信息、测量并安放电极、记录与监测患者、识别伪迹、整理技术数据并向医师提交汇总报告。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、准备要求、中美统计口径与授权边界。

en.name: Neurologists
en.summary: Neurologists (O*NET-SOC 29-1217.00) diagnose, manage, and treat diseases and disorders of the brain, spinal cord, and peripheral nerves non-surgically: collecting history and family history, completing neurological examinations, ordering and interpreting laboratory and neuroimaging studies, making a differential diagnosis, developing and adjusting treatment plans, monitoring medication adverse effects, determining brain death, arranging supportive care and referrals, and communicating and recording with the multidisciplinary team. This page uses only official sources to explain the occupation scope, tasks, preparation requirements, Chinese and United States statistical scopes, and authorization boundaries.

zh.name: 神经科医师
zh.summary: 神经科医师（O*NET-SOC 29-1217.00）以非手术方式诊断、管理并治疗脑、脊髓与周围神经的疾病与病症：采集病史与家族史、完成神经系统检查、开具并解读实验室与神经影像检查、作出鉴别诊断、制定并调整治疗方案、监测药物不良反应、判定脑死亡、安排支持性照护与转诊，并与多学科团队沟通和记录。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、准备要求、中美统计口径与授权边界。

en.name: Neuropsychologists
en.summary: Neuropsychologists integrate history, interviews, standardized tests, and behavior observations to explain cognitive and behavioral findings to referral teams. Clinical assessment and report sign-off depend on licensure, training, and facility authorization.

zh.name: 神经心理学家
zh.summary: 神经心理学家整合病史、访谈、标准化测验和行为观察，向转诊团队解释认知与行为表现。临床评估与签发报告依执照、训练和机构授权。

en.name: New accounts clerks
en.summary: New accounts clerks (O*NET-SOC 43-4141.00) handle account-opening stages at banks and other depository financial institutions: interviewing customers, verifying identity documents and materials, explaining account and service terms, entering account information into systems and filing records, handling counter payments, transfers and error correction as needed, and escalating abnormalities in customer identity or transactions under institutional procedures. This page uses only official sources to explain occupational scope, tasks, preparation requirements, Chinese and US statistical definitions, and authorization boundaries.

zh.name: 新账户文员
zh.summary: 新账户文员（O*NET-SOC 43-4141.00）在银行及其他存款类金融机构负责开户环节：面谈客户、核验身份证件与资料、说明账户与服务条款、把账户信息录入系统并归档，同时按需承担柜面收付、转账与错误更正，并在客户身份或交易出现异常时按机构流程升级。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、准备要求、中美统计口径与授权边界。

en.name: Nondestructive testing specialists
en.summary: Nondestructive testing specialists (O*NET-SOC 17-3029.01) inspect structures and equipment for defects without damaging the inspected object. They select, calibrate and operate ultrasonic, radiographic, magnetic particle, penetrant, eddy current and acoustic emission testing equipment according to standards and procedures, interpret signals and images, evaluate results against codes, document methods and processes and prepare inspection reports, while meeting radiation and on-site work safety requirements. This page uses only official sources to explain occupational scope, tasks, preparation requirements, Chinese and US statistical definitions, and authorization boundaries.

zh.name: 无损检测专员
zh.summary: 无损检测专员（O*NET-SOC 17-3029.01）在不破坏被检对象的前提下检查结构与设备缺陷：按标准与程序选择、校准并操作超声、射线、磁粉、渗透、涡流、声发射等检测设备，判读检测信号与图像，依据规范评估结果、记录方法与过程并编写检测报告，同时承担辐射与现场作业安全要求。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、准备要求、中美统计口径与授权边界。

en.name: Nuclear engineers
en.summary: Nuclear engineers (O*NET-SOC 17-2161.00) apply nuclear science and engineering principles to research, design and operations involving nuclear energy and waste: designing reactor cores, radiation shielding, and instrumentation and control equipment; monitoring nuclear facility operations and identifying designs and operations that violate safety regulations or endanger safety; initiating corrective actions or ordering reactor shutdown in emergencies; writing operating procedures and technical reports; participating in environmental compliance, waste disposal and decommissioning plans; and communicating with regulators, suppliers and review committees. This page uses only official sources to explain occupational scope, tasks, preparation requirements, Chinese and US statistical definitions, and authorization boundaries.

zh.name: 核工程师
zh.summary: 核工程师（O*NET-SOC 17-2161.00）把核科学与工程原理用于核能与核废料相关问题的研究、设计与运行：设计反应堆堆芯、辐射屏蔽与仪控设备，监控核设施运行并识别违反安全法规或危及安全的设计与操作，在紧急情况下启动纠正措施或下令停堆，编写操作规程与技术报告，参与环境合规、废物处置与退役计划，并与监管机构、供应商和审查委员会沟通。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、准备要求、中美统计口径与授权边界。

en.name: Nuclear medicine technologists
en.summary: Nuclear medicine technologists (O*NET-SOC 29-2033.00) prepare, administer and measure radioisotopes under physician direction for diagnosis, treatment and tracer research: preparing radiopharmaceuticals and calculating and recording doses under requirements, operating gamma cameras, PET and other imaging equipment, processing quantitative study data such as cardiac function, explaining procedures and safety precautions to patients, performing equipment quality control, and storing drugs and disposing of radioactive waste under radiation safety procedures. This page uses only official sources to explain occupational scope, tasks, preparation requirements, Chinese and US statistical definitions, and authorization boundaries.

zh.name: 核医学技师
zh.summary: 核医学技师（O*NET-SOC 29-2033.00）在医师指导下准备、施用并测量放射性同位素，用于诊断、治疗与示踪研究：制备放射性药物并按规定计算、记录剂量，操作伽马相机与 PET 等设备成像，处理心脏功能等定量研究数据，向患者解释程序与安全注意事项，执行设备质量控制，并按辐射安全程序储存药物、处置放射性废物。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、准备要求、中美统计口径与授权边界。

en.name: Nuclear monitoring technicians
en.summary: Nuclear monitoring technicians (O*NET-SOC 19-4051.02) collect and test samples to monitor nuclear experiment results and radioactive contamination of personnel, facilities and the environment: using detectors and instruments to determine radiation intensity and type in work areas, equipment or materials; monitoring personnel exposure and area radiation levels; calculating safe exposure times from site contamination readings and prescribed safety levels; collecting and analyzing air, water, gas or solid samples; installing and testing area radiation alarm equipment; providing initial response to alarms or abnormal events; guiding radiation safety procedures and protective equipment use; preparing contamination testing and decontamination reports and radiation work permits; and disposing of radioactive waste under procedures. This page uses only official sources to explain occupational scope, tasks, preparation requirements, Chinese and US statistical definitions, and authorization boundaries.

zh.name: 核监测技术员
zh.summary: 核监测技术员（O*NET-SOC 19-4051.02）采集并检测样本，用于监测核实验结果以及人员、设施和环境的放射性污染：使用探测器与仪器测定工作区、设备或材料中辐射的强度与类型，监测人员受照量与区域辐射水平，按厂区污染读数与规定安全水平计算安全受照时间，采集并分析空气、水、气体或固体样本，安装与测试区域辐射异常报警设备，在报警或异常事件中先期响应，指导人员执行辐射安全程序与防护装备使用，编写污染检测、去污报告与放射工作许可，并按程序处置放射性废物。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、准备要求、中美统计口径与授权边界。

en.name: Power operators
en.summary: Power operators (O*NET-SOC 51-8011.00, Nuclear Power Reactor Operators) operate or control nuclear reactors from nuclear power plant main control rooms: moving control rods and regulating reactivity and power under standard procedures, monitoring coolant temperature and flow, and starting and stopping equipment; monitoring plant-wide operating parameters, recording operating data and performing periodic tests; determining causes of abnormalities and recommending or taking corrective action; implementing lockout, tagging and isolation to support maintenance; responding to accident conditions under emergency operating procedures; and participating in authorization and supervision of nuclear fuel handling, radiation monitoring and sampling.
