This page uses only official sources to explain occupational scope, tasks, Chinese and US qualification and authorization boundaries, and wage and employment statistical definitions.

zh.name: 电力操作员
zh.summary: 电力操作员（O*NET-SOC 51-8011.00，Nuclear Power Reactor Operators）在核动力厂主控室操作或控制核反应堆：按标准程序移动控制棒、调节反应性与功率水平，监控冷却剂温度与流量，启动和停止设备；监视全厂系统运行参数、记录运行数据并执行定期试验；出现异常时判断原因、提出或执行纠正措施；实施锁定、挂牌与隔离等安全措施以支持检修，按应急运行程序处置事故工况，并参与核燃料操作、辐射与取样监测的授权与监督。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、中美资格与授权边界，以及工资与就业统计口径。

en.name: Nuclear Technicians
en.summary: Nuclear Technicians (O*NET-SOC 19-4051.00, Nuclear Technicians) assist nuclear physicists, nuclear engineers, or other scientists in laboratory, power generation, and electricity production activities: operating, testing, and maintaining nuclear equipment according to nuclear equipment operating policies and radiation worker procedures, performing surveillance tests to judge equipment safety status, monitoring reactor equipment performance and identifying inefficiencies, hazards, or maintenance needs, tagging equipment awaiting repair and implementing isolation, using detectors or other instruments to measure the intensity and type of radiation in work areas, equipment, or materials, calculating operating factors such as exposure time, dose, and gamma intensity using standard formulas, collecting and testing air, water, gas, or solid samples, performing decontamination, and setting up area radiation anomaly alarm devices. This page uses only official sources to explain the occupational scope, tasks, Chinese and U.S. statistical scope, and authorization boundaries.

zh.name: 核技术员
zh.summary: 核技术员（O*NET-SOC 19-4051.00，Nuclear Technicians）协助核物理学家、核工程师或其他科学家开展实验室、发电与电力生产活动：按核设备操作政策和辐射工作人员程序操作、测试与维护核设备，执行监视试验判断设备安全状态，监控反应堆设备性能并识别低效、隐患或检修需要，为待修设备挂牌并落实隔离，使用探测器或其他仪器测量工作区、设备或材料中辐射的强度与类型，按标准公式计算受照时间、剂量与伽马强度等运行因数，采集并检测空气、水、气体或固体样本，执行去污并设置区域辐射异常报警装置。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、中美统计口径与授权边界。

en.name: Nurse Anesthetists
en.summary: Nurse Anesthetists (O*NET-SOC 29-1151.00, Nurse Anesthetists) administer anesthesia, monitor patient vital signs, and supervise patients recovering from anesthesia, and may assist anesthesiologists, surgeons, other physicians, or dentists; this occupation in the United States requires a registered nurse with graduate professional education. The work includes pre-anesthesia screening and medical history assessment, developing an anesthesia nursing plan, obtaining informed consent, selecting and administering anesthesia and adjunct medications, performing regional anesthesia, managing the airway and mechanical ventilation, calibrating and testing anesthesia equipment, continuously monitoring vital signs with invasive and non-invasive techniques, handling peri-anesthesia emergencies, inserting peripheral or central venous and arterial catheters, evaluating post-anesthesia response and deciding on post-anesthesia care discharge, and teaching nursing staff and residents. This page uses only official sources to explain the occupational scope, tasks, China-U.S. admission differences, and statistical scope.

zh.name: 麻醉护士
zh.summary: 麻醉护士（O*NET-SOC 29-1151.00，Nurse Anesthetists）实施麻醉、监测患者生命体征并监护患者从麻醉中恢复，可协助麻醉医师、外科医师、其他医师或牙医；该职业在美国要求为接受过研究生专业教育的注册护士。工作内容包括麻醉前筛查与病史评估、制定麻醉护理计划、获取知情同意、选择与给予麻醉及辅助药物、实施区域麻醉、管理气道与机械通气、校准与测试麻醉设备、用侵入性与非侵入性技术持续监测生命体征、处置围麻醉期紧急情况、置入外周或中心静脉与动脉导管、评估麻醉后反应并决定麻醉后护理出院，并对护理人员与住院医师开展教学。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、中美准入差异与统计口径。

en.name: Nurse Midwives
en.summary: Nurse Midwives (O*NET-SOC 29-1161.00, Nurse Midwives) diagnose and coordinate all aspects of the birth process independently or within a medical team, and may provide gynecological care for healthy women; this occupation in the United States requires professional graduate nursing education. The work includes providing antenatal, intrapartum, postpartum, and newborn care, monitoring fetal development by listening to fetal heart tones, external uterine measurement, identifying fetal position, and estimating fetal size, recording health history and physical examination findings, performing vital sign, reflex, breast, and pelvic examinations, prescribing medications within the scope permitted by state regulations, ordering and interpreting diagnostic or laboratory tests, providing family planning services and individualized health management plans, initiating emergency interventions to stabilize patients, consulting or referring to specialists when the condition exceeds the scope of practice, educating patients, families, staff, and the community, and instructing student midwives and medical students. This page uses only official sources to explain the occupational scope, tasks, China-U.S. admission differences, and statistical scope.

zh.name: 护士助产士
zh.summary: 护士助产士（O*NET-SOC 29-1161.00，Nurse Midwives）独立或在医疗团队中诊断并协调分娩过程的各个方面，并可提供健康女性的妇科护理；该职业在美国要求接受专业的研究生护理教育。工作内容包括提供产前、产中、产后与新生儿护理，通过听胎心、外部子宫测量、识别胎位与估算胎儿大小监测胎儿发育，记录健康史与体格检查结果，执行生命体征、反射、乳房与盆腔检查，在州法规允许范围内开具药物，开具并解读诊断或实验室检查，提供计划生育服务与个性化健康管理计划，启动紧急干预以稳定患者，在病情超出执业范围时咨询或转诊专科人员，并对患者、家属、员工与社区开展教育以及指导实习助产士与医学生。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、中美准入差异与统计口径。

en.name: Nurse Practitioners
en.summary: Nurse Practitioners (O*NET-SOC 29-1171.00, Nurse Practitioners) diagnose and treat acute, episodic, or chronic illness independently or as a member of a healthcare team, with a focus on health promotion and disease prevention; they may order, perform, or interpret diagnostic tests such as laboratory work and imaging and may prescribe medications. This occupation in the United States requires a registered nurse with professional graduate education. This page uses only official sources to explain the occupational scope, tasks, China-U.S. admission differences, and statistical scope.

zh.name: 执业护士
zh.summary: 执业护士（O*NET-SOC 29-1171.00，Nurse Practitioners）独立或作为医疗团队的一员诊断并治疗急性、偶发性或慢性疾病，侧重健康促进与疾病预防；可开具、执行或解读实验室与影像等诊断检查，并可开具药物。该职业在美国须为接受专业研究生教育的注册护士。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、中美准入差异与统计口径。

en.name: Nursing assistants
en.summary: Nursing assistants (O*NET-SOC 31-1131.00, Nursing Assistants) provide or assist with basic care under the direction of licensed nursing staff, including monitoring health status, feeding, bathing, dressing, grooming, toileting, and patient transfer, in medical or nursing facilities, and may administer medication under direction and complete other health-related tasks. This page uses only official sources to explain occupational scope, tasks, China-U.S. access differences, and statistical measures.

zh.name: 护理员
zh.summary: 护理员（O*NET-SOC 31-1131.00，Nursing Assistants）在持证护理人员的指导下提供或协助基础照护，包括观察健康状况、喂食、沐浴、穿衣、仪容整理、如厕与患者转运等，工作场所为医疗机构或护理机构，并可能在指导下给药及完成其他健康相关任务。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、中美准入差异与统计口径。

en.name: Obstetricians and gynecologists
en.summary: Obstetricians and gynecologists (O*NET-SOC 29-1218.00, Obstetricians and Gynecologists) provide medical care related to pregnancy and childbirth, diagnose, treat, and help prevent diseases of women, especially those affecting the reproductive system, and may also provide general care for women and take on obstetric and gynecological surgery; in the United States, medical school education and residency training must be completed and a state license to practice obtained, while in mainland China licensed physician qualification and completed registration are required, and techniques such as midwifery also require a special maternal and child health technical service license.

zh.name: 妇产科医师
zh.summary: 妇产科医师（O*NET-SOC 29-1218.00，Obstetricians and Gynecologists）提供与妊娠和分娩相关的医疗照护，诊断、治疗并帮助预防女性疾病，尤其是影响生殖系统的疾病，也可提供女性一般照护并承担妇产科手术；美国须完成医学院教育与住院医师培训并取得州级行医许可，中国大陆须取得执业医师资格并完成注册，开展助产等技术还需专项母婴保健技术服务许可。

en.name: Occupational health and safety specialists
en.summary: Occupational health and safety specialists (O*NET19-5011.00) analyze work environments, design occupational health and safety programs, check compliance, and investigate accidents. In the United States JobZone4 requires considerable preparation; scope of responsibility｜some U.S. employers require or prefer professional certification, and certification is not a government license. In mainland China, safety management personnel assessment, registered safety engineer requirements, and institutional post authorization are verified by industry and post, and not all occupational health posts uniformly require a registered safety engineer; only after obtaining the qualification certificate and completing registration may one practice under the name of registered safety engineer. Testing and evaluation of occupational disease hazard factors are undertaken by occupational health technical service institutions with the corresponding qualification accreditation, while routine monitoring, medical health examinations, and occupational disease diagnosis follow separate rules and must not be lumped into one category.

zh.name: 作业健康专员
zh.summary: 作业健康专员（O*NET19-5011.00）分析工作环境，设计职业健康安全方案，检查合规与调查事故。美国JobZone4需相当准备；责任边界｜美国部分雇主要求或优先专业认证，认证不等政府许可。中国大陆按行业与岗位核安全管理人员考核、注册安全工程师要求及机构岗位授权，不把所有职业健康岗位一律要求注安师；取得资格证书后经注册才可用注册安全工程师名义执业。职业病危害因素检测、评价由有相应资质认可的职业卫生技术服务机构承担，日常监测、医疗健康检查和职业病诊断另有规则，不能混为一类。

en.name: Operations research analyst
en.summary: Use mathematical modeling, optimization, simulation, and data analysis to help organizations compare options under constraints such as cost, time, resources, and logistics, and explain assumptions and limitations to decision makers.

zh.name: 运筹分析师
zh.summary: 用数学建模、优化、仿真和数据分析帮助机构在成本、时间、资源及物流等约束下比较方案，并向决策者解释假设和局限。

en.name: Dispensing optician
en.summary: Measure the customer's face and pupillary distance based on a written optical prescription, help select frames and lenses, send work orders to the laboratory, verify finished-glasses parameters, and adjust the fit; does not independently diagnose or prescribe.

zh.name: 配镜师
zh.summary: 依据书面光学处方测量顾客面部与瞳距，帮助选择镜架和镜片，向实验室下达加工单，核成镜参数并调整佩戴；不独立诊断或开处方。

en.name: Optometrist
en.summary: This page describes U.S. Optometrists, O*NET 29-1041.00: examining the eyes and visual system, diagnosing and managing conditions within state-authorized practice, and prescribing corrective lenses. Medication and some procedural permissions vary by state; care beyond the practitioner’s scope or expertise requires referral.

zh.name: 验光师
zh.summary: 本页按美国O*NET 29-1041.00介绍Optometrists：检查眼和视觉系统，在州许可范围内诊断、管理和治疗相关问题，并开具矫正镜片处方。药物及部分操作权限因州而异；超出本人执业范围或经验时转诊。

en.name: Hand packer
en.summary: According to orders and packaging specifications, manually inspect, meter, sort, box, seal, and label products, record quantities and anomalies, and deliver verifiable parcels or batches.

zh.name: 手工包装工
zh.summary: 按订单和包装规范，人工检查、计量、分拣、装箱、封口和贴标产品，记录数量与异常，交付可核对的包裹或批次。

en.name: Paving, Surfacing, and Tamping Equipment Operators
en.summary: Paving, surfacing, and tamping equipment operators (O*NET 47-2071.00) run asphalt or concrete paving, leveling, and compacting equipment, working to road elevation, thickness, and the construction plan alongside dump trucks and ground personnel, checking equipment condition and recording anomalies. Before work, on-site traffic control, equipment training, and employer authorization should be verified.

zh.name: 铺路与压实设备操作员
zh.summary: 铺路与压实设备操作员（O*NET 47-2071.00）操作沥青或混凝土摊铺、整平与压实设备，按路面标高、厚度和施工方案与运料车、地面人员协作，检查设备状态并记录异常。工作前应核对现场交通管制、设备培训和雇主授权。

en.name: Personal Financial Advisors
en.summary: Personal financial advisors review clients’ goals, cash flow and tolerance for risk before discussing options and follow-up. In a review, they separate changes in the client’s circumstances from assumptions in the original plan.

zh.name: 个人理财顾问
zh.summary: 个人理财顾问先梳理客户的目标、收支和风险承受能力，再讨论方案和后续复核。定期会谈需要区分客户情况变化与原方案的假设。

en.name: Pharmacists
en.summary: Pharmacists review prescriptions, dispense or oversee dispensing, and counsel patients. A prescription discrepancy calls for checking the record and contacting the appropriate clinician through the workplace process.

zh.name: 药剂师
zh.summary: 药师审核处方、调配或监督调配，并向患者解释用药信息。发现处方疑点时，药师核对记录并按工作流程联系相关临床人员。

en.name: Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation Physicians
en.summary: Physical medicine and rehabilitation physicians assess movement and daily function, set rehabilitation goals and coordinate with the therapy team. Follow-up combines the task conditions with recorded measures of function.

zh.name: 物理医学与康复医师
zh.summary: 康复医学医师评估活动和日常功能，制定康复目标并与治疗团队协调。复诊时结合任务条件和测量记录判断功能变化。

en.name: Physical therapist assistants
en.summary: U.S. physical therapist assistants deliver assigned care under a physical therapist’s supervision, observe changes and report back. Similar mainland job titles can mean helping a rehabilitation technician or operating equipment only. Check the actual job and local credentials before choosing training.

zh.name: 物理治疗师助理
zh.summary: 美国物理治疗师助理（PTA）在物理治疗师监督下实施指定治疗、观察变化并报告。大陆招聘里相近名称的助理，可能协助物理因子治疗，也可能只操作设备；选课程前先核目标岗位和当地资格。

en.name: Physician assistants
en.summary: Physician assistants assess patients, document care and participate in follow-up within applicable practice rules and team arrangements. Pending results go to the authorized clinician for review.

zh.name: 医师助理
zh.summary: 医师助理在适用执业范围和团队安排内评估患者、记录诊疗信息并参与后续照护。待复核的结果应交给有权限的临床人员。

en.name: Political Science Teachers, Postsecondary
en.summary: Postsecondary political science teachers teach institutions, behavior and ideas, and help students formulate and test arguments with evidence. Comparisons require attention to the time and institutional context of a source.

zh.name: 高校政治学教师
zh.summary: 高校政治学教师讲授政治制度、行为与思想，并指导学生用材料提出和检验论点。课堂比较通常需要说明材料的时间和制度背景。

en.name: Prepress Technicians and Workers
en.summary: Prepress technicians turn the text, images, fonts, and layout of a design file into a printable file, performing file preflight, proofing, and quality control, with some positions making printing plates. O*NET 51-5111.00 lists proofing, proofreading, layout, font and image file checking, and plate making as tasks. File release follows customer confirmation, equipment specifications, and in-plant procedures, and a screen preview cannot replace the printed result.

zh.name: 印前技术员与工人
zh.summary: 印前技术员把设计稿的文字、图像、字体和版式整理为可印刷文件，执行文件预检、校样和质量控制，部分岗位制作印版。O*NET 51-5111.00列打样、校对、排版、字体图像文件检查与制版为任务。文件放行要按客户确认、设备规格与厂内流程，不能以屏幕预览代替印刷结果。

en.name: Production planning and expediting clerks
en.summary: Production planning and expediting clerks coordinate work orders and material flow between departments according to the production schedule, distribute and adjust schedules, check progress and completion dates with supervisors, and compile records of inventory, cost, bottlenecks, and delays. Schedule changes must note resource conditions and the approver, and expediting must not replace safety or quality judgment.

zh.name: 生产计划与催单文员
zh.summary: 生产计划与催单文员按照生产日程协调部门间的工单和物料流转，分发与调整排程，向主管核进度和完工日期，并整理库存、成本、瓶颈与延误记录。排程变更须标资源条件和批准人，不能用催单替代安全或质量判断。

en.name: Psychiatric Aides
en.summary: Psychiatric aides help with daily activities under nursing and medical staff direction and report observations during handoff. Duties depend on the setting.

zh.name: 精神科护理助理
zh.summary: 精神科护理辅助岗位按护理与医疗团队分工协助日常活动，观察变化并交班，具体任务以所在机构为准。

en.name: Public Relations Specialists
en.summary: Public relations specialists shape and maintain the public image of an organization or individual, verify data, write press releases and media Q&A, respond to media information requests, update website and social platform content, and maintain community and media relationships. Important statements, sensitive data disclosure, and organizational commitments are approved by authorized personnel.

zh.name: 公共关系专员
zh.summary: 公共关系专员为组织或个人塑造并维护公众形象，核实资料、撰写新闻稿和媒体问答，回应媒体信息请求，更新网站与社交平台内容，并维护社区和媒体关系。重要声明、敏感资料披露与组织承诺依获授权人员审批。

en.name: Quality Control Analysts
en.summary: Quality control analysts test raw materials, bulk intermediates, and finished products using standard methods, compare results with specifications and control limits and propose release recommendations, and also calibrate and maintain equipment, record data, write deviation reports, and take part in out-of-specification investigations. This page uses the precise US O*NET occupation 19-4099.01; the US wages and employment projections only go up to the BLS SOC 19-4099 "other life, physical, and social science technicians" broad category and are not a dedicated 19-4099.01 value, so the two cannot be substituted for each other. For China no verifiable precise occupational wage was obtained, and the insufficient-evidence marker is retained.

zh.name: 质量控制分析师
zh.summary: 质量控制分析师按标准方法测试原材料、散装中间体和成品，把结果与规格和控制限比较并提出放行建议，同时校准与维护设备、记录数据、撰写偏差报告并参与超标调查。本页采用美国 O*NET 19-4099.01 精确职业；美国工资与就业预测只到 BLS SOC 19-4099「其他生命、物理与社会科学技术人员」大类，不是 19-4099.01 单列值，两者不能互相替换。中国区未取得可核验的精确职业工资，保留证据不足标记。

en.name: Quality control systems manager
en.summary: Quality control systems managers plan, direct, or coordinate quality assurance programs: they set quality control policies, control the quality of laboratory and production work, maintain quality system documents, and drive production stops and correction when serious defects appear. This page uses the US O*NET detailed occupation Quality Control Systems Managers (11-3051.01); the US wages and employment use the SOC 11-3051 category (industrial production managers) that contains this occupation, not a narrower single-occupation value. No verifiable wage for the detailed occupation was obtained for China, and an insufficient evidence marker is retained.

zh.name: 质量控制系统经理
zh.summary: 质量控制系统经理规划、指导或协调质量保证计划：制定质量控制政策，控制实验室与生产工作的质量，维护质量体系文件，并在出现严重缺陷时推动停止生产与纠偏。本页采用美国 O*NET 精确职业 Quality Control Systems Managers（11-3051.01）；美国工资与就业使用包含本职业的 SOC 11-3051 大类（工业生产经营经理）口径，不是更窄的单列职业值。中国区未取得可核验的精确职业工资，保留证据不足标记。

en.name: Radiologic Technologists and Technicians
en.summary: Radiologic technologists and technicians carry out X-ray, CT and other imaging work under examination requests and applicable protocols: identity and site checks, patient preparation and positioning, authorized exposure settings, image acquisition, technical image-quality evaluation and documentation. Technical evaluation is not disease diagnosis. Contrast-related duties require applicable legal and professional conditions and physician guidance. U.S. wages use exact occupation 29-2034; this page’s employment overview uses the combined radiologic and MRI group. Mainland China education, recruitment, professional-title qualifications and applicable radiation-worker requirements are considered separately; exact national or city occupational wages remain unavailable.

zh.name: 放射技师与技术员
zh.summary: 放射技师与技术员按检查申请和适用规程开展X光、CT等成像工作，包括身份与部位核对、患者准备与摆位、获准范围内的曝光条件设置、图像采集、技术图像质量评价及记录。技术质量评价不等于疾病诊断；造影相关任务须符合法律、专业条件及医师指导。美国工资采用29-2034精确职业口径，本页就业概览采用放射与MRI合并组。大陆部分分别解释教育、招聘、卫生专业技术资格和适用的放射工作人员要求，尚无可用的本职业全国或城市精确工资。

en.name: Rail Car Repairer
en.summary: Rail car repairers diagnose, adjust, repair or overhaul railroad rolling stock, mine cars or rail transit vehicles: inspect bodies, roofs, doors, bearings, seals, wheels, couplers and other components for defects and wear; remove or replace faulty and worn parts; repair, fabricate and install steel or wooden fittings according to drawings; service electrical controls for propulsion and braking systems; install car ends, crossmembers and interiors and adjust car bodies; test and adjust units before and after repair; record vehicle conditions and maintenance work and perform scheduled maintenance. This page uses the exact U.S. O*NET occupation Rail Car Repairers (49-3043.00). U.S. wages use its OEWS percentiles; unavailable industry-specific medians retain an insufficient-evidence label. No verifiable occupation-specific wage data were obtained for China, so that insufficient-evidence label is also retained.

zh.name: 铁路车辆修理工
zh.summary: 铁路车辆修理工诊断、调整、修理或大修铁路机车车辆、矿车或轨道交通车辆：检查车体、车顶、车门与轴承、密封、车轮、车钩等部件的缺陷与磨损；拆卸或更换故障与磨损部件；按图纸修理、制造并安装钢制或木制配件；检修推进与制动系统的电气控制；安装车端、横梁与车内装修并调整车体；在修理前后测试与调整机组；记录车况与维修工作并执行计划保养。本页采用美国 O*NET 精确职业 Rail Car Repairers（49-3043.00）；美国工资按其 OEWS 分位给出，行业分列中位数未取得时保留证据不足。中国区未取得可核验的精确职业工资，保留证据不足标记。

en.name: Maintenance operators
en.summary: Track equipment operators install and maintain rails, switches, and ballast. Identify the exact track section and record the defect before handing it off. Ask who operates the equipment, checks the repair, and authorizes reopening.

zh.name: 维护操作员
zh.summary: 线路铺设与维护设备岗位维护轨距、轨面及道床状态，工作从识别具体区段和记录缺陷开始。先分清设备操作、复测与恢复线路使用各由谁负责。

en.name: Rail yard engineers, dinkey operators, and hostlers
en.summary: Rail yard engineers and related operators move locomotives within yards or industrial sites. Their work includes equipment checks and confirming signals and switching instructions with ground crews.

zh.name: 工程师操作员
zh.summary: 调车机车司机及相关设备操作岗位负责站场内机车移动。上岗前检查设备、确认所接收的信号和调车指令，与地面人员核对交接。

en.name: Railroad brake, signal, and switch operators
en.summary: This occupational group supports train and yard movements by checking signals, car connections, and brake tests and handing off exceptions. Actual duties depend on the operator and assignment.

zh.name: 铁路、信号、操作员
zh.summary: 这组岗位从地面或列车侧配合调车，重点是核对信号、连接状态和制动测试，并把异常交给负责人员。具体岗位覆盖哪些任务，以单位分工为准。

en.name: Railroad Conductors and Yardmasters
en.summary: U.S. O*NET 53-4031.00 groups two work settings: conductors coordinate crews on passenger or freight trains, while yardmasters review schedules and switching sequences and coordinate work in the yard. Duties may overlap. In mainland China, check on-board passenger service, station operations and switching as separate roles.

zh.name: 铁路列车长与调车场主管
zh.summary: 美国 O*NET 53-4031.00 把两种工作归在一项：列车长协调客运或货运列车上的乘务组，调车场主管核对列车计划和调车顺序、协调场内作业。两类工作可能交叉；大陆的客运列车长、车站行车与调车工种应分别核职责。

en.name: Range Managers
en.summary: Range managers track vegetation, land use, and long-term productivity, compare management options, and document follow-up monitoring.

zh.name: 牧场资源经理
zh.summary: 草地管理岗位跟踪植被、土地利用和长期生产条件，比较管理方案并记录后续监测。

en.name: Real Estate Brokers
en.summary: Real estate brokers may handle transactions and run a brokerage, review files, or supervise agents. Check whether the role includes responsibility for office operations and transaction oversight.

zh.name: 房地产经纪人
zh.summary: 房地产经纪负责人既参与交易，也可能经营经纪业务、复核文件并指导销售人员。先看岗位是否承担办公室与代理流程责任。

en.name: Respiratory Therapists
en.summary: Respiratory therapists assess respiratory-care needs, check equipment, document observations, and hand off changes within team plans and authority.

zh.name: 呼吸治疗师
zh.summary: 呼吸治疗师在团队计划和授权下评估呼吸照护需要，检查设备、记录观察并交接变化。

en.name: Sales Engineers
en.summary: Sales engineers sell commercial products or services that require an engineering-degree level of technical background, clarify customer technical requirements, prepare proposals, organize demonstrations or trials, explain technical and commercial terms, and hand over verified capabilities and unresolved risks to the sales and delivery teams.

zh.name: 销售工程师
zh.summary: 销售工程师销售需要工程学位水平技术背景的商业产品或服务，澄清客户技术需求、准备方案、组织演示或试用、解释技术与商业条件，并把已验证能力和未解决风险交给销售及交付团队。

en.name: Sales Representatives of Services, Except Advertising, Insurance, Financial Services, and Travel
en.summary: Service sales representatives learn client needs, explain scope and terms, and coordinate quotes and handoffs. Authority to make commitments depends on the service.

zh.name: 服务销售代表（广告、保险、金融与旅游除外）
zh.summary: 服务销售代表了解客户需求，解释服务范围和条件，协调报价及后续交接。不同服务的承诺权限各异。

en.name: Security and Fire Alarm Systems Installers
en.summary: Security and fire alarm systems installers (O*NET 49-2098) install, program, maintain and repair alarm equipment per work orders and drawings, test circuits, sensors, backup batteries and alarm functions, and explain use and false alarm handling to clients. Construction, fire and electrical requirements follow local codes and authorization.

zh.name: 安全消防系统安装工
zh.summary: 安防与火警系统安装员（O*NET 49-2098）按工作单和图纸安装、编程、维护和修理报警设备，测试电路、传感器、备用电池及告警功能，并向客户说明使用与误报处理。施工、消防和电气要求按所在地规范及授权执行。

en.name: Security Guards
en.summary: Security guards (O*NET 33-9032) patrol or monitor premises, verify entry and exit permissions, watch for theft, violence and rule violations, and record and report anomalies. Specific response, equipment and training follow local and employer rules; this occupation is not the same as police or security and fire alarm systems installers.

zh.name: 安全警卫
zh.summary: 安全警卫（O*NET 33-9032）巡查或监控场所，核对出入权限，观察盗窃、暴力及规则违规风险，记录并报告异常。具体处置、装备和培训依所在地与雇主规定；本职业不等同警察或安防系统安装员。

en.name: Segmental Pavers
en.summary: Segmental pavers lay out, cut, and install paving units, documenting edges, coverage, and areas awaiting review.

zh.name: 块状铺路工
zh.summary: 块材铺装岗位按项目布局放样、切配和铺设铺块，记录边缘、铺装范围与待复核位置。

en.name: Separating, Filtering, Clarifying, Precipitating, and Still Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
en.summary: Separation and filtration equipment workers set up or monitor process equipment and record batches, samples, and anomalies. Materials and processes vary by industry.

zh.name: 分离、过滤、澄清、沉淀及蒸馏设备操作员
zh.summary: 分离和过滤等设备岗位按工艺要求设置或监看设备，记录批次、取样和异常，具体介质与流程随行业而异。

en.name: Septic Tank Servicers and Sewer Pipe Cleaners
en.summary: Septic and sewer maintenance workers inspect, clean, or repair designated systems and record blockages, work performed, and follow-up checks.

zh.name: 化粪池维护及下水管道清洁工
zh.summary: 化粪池及排水管维护岗位检查、清理或修理指定设施，记录堵塞位置、已做工作及复核事项。

en.name: Service Unit Operators, Oil and Gas
en.summary: Oil and gas service unit operators support work on producing wells or assist with well obstructions under an approved plan, documenting equipment, conditions, and handoffs.

zh.name: 石油天然气井服务机组操作员
zh.summary: 油气井服务设备操作岗位按作业方案支持在产井服务或井内障碍处理，记录设备、工况和授权交接。

en.name: Sewers, Hand
en.summary: Hand sewers stitch, reinforce, and finish products against samples or work orders, then check materials and finish quality.

zh.name: 缝纫工、手工
zh.summary: 手工缝制岗位按样件或工单缝合、加固和整理制品，核材料、针脚和完成质量。

en.name: Sewing Machine Operators
en.summary: Sewing machine operators thread machines, position and guide fabric or other products according to process sheets, and machine sew, reinforce, or decorate them; they monitor broken threads, stitch defects, and equipment irregularities and check dimensions and appearance. Equipment types, materials, and shifts depend on the target position.

zh.name: 缝纫机操作员
zh.summary: 缝纫机操作员按工序单装线、定位并导引面料或其他制品，经机器缝合、加固或装饰；监看断线、线迹缺陷和设备异常，检查尺寸与外观。设备类型、材料及班次以目标岗位为准。

en.name: Ship Engineers
en.summary: Ship engineers coordinate shipboard machinery, electrical systems, and related maintenance. Watches and review responsibilities depend on vessel and rank.

zh.name: 船舶工程师
zh.summary: 船舶轮机岗位协调船上机械、电气及相关设备的运行维护，跟踪值班、缺陷和复核，具体职责随船型和职级而异。

en.name: Shipping, receiving, and inventory clerks
en.summary: Shipping, receiving, and inventory clerks match orders and shipping records to goods on hand, prepare documents and report shortages, damage or lot mismatches. Check who can adjust inventory, release goods after inspection or operate warehouse equipment.

zh.name: 收发货与库存文员
zh.summary: 收发货与库存文员核对订单、运单、实物和库存记录，整理出入库单据，发现少货、破损或批次不符时登记并交接。库存调整、质检放行与设备操作是否由你负责，要看岗位和授权。

en.name: Shuttle drivers and chauffeurs
en.summary: Shuttle drivers and chauffeurs transport passengers on scheduled or booked trips, checking routes, timing, and handoff requirements. Vehicle and licensing requirements vary.

zh.name: 穿梭车司机专车司机
zh.summary: 接驳及专车驾驶岗位按预约或班次运送乘客，核路线、时间和特殊交接要求。车型、执照和服务范围需按当地及雇主核对。

en.name: Skincare specialists
en.summary: Skincare specialists confirm client needs, prepare services, and document what was provided. Services and equipment permitted depend on local rules and the business.

zh.name: 护肤专家
zh.summary: 皮肤护理服务岗位确认顾客需求、准备项目并记录服务。服务内容、设备和可开展范围随当地规则及机构而异。

en.name: Special education teachers (middle school)
en.summary: Middle school special education teachers support participation across subjects and track academic, self-management, and social goals with classroom teachers.

zh.name: 特殊教育教师（初中）
zh.summary: 初中特殊教育教师协助学生参与多门学科课程，跟踪课业、自我管理和社会技能目标，与学科教师协调材料与复核。

en.name: Special education teachers (preschool)
en.summary: Preschool special education teachers adapt play and early learning, observe communication and participation, and share records with families and school teams.

zh.name: 特殊教育教师（学前）
zh.summary: 学前特殊教育教师调整游戏和早期学习活动，观察沟通、参与和生活技能，并与家庭和园所团队交换记录。

en.name: Statistical assistants
en.summary: Statistical assistants prepare data, compute summaries under specified rules, and produce tables or charts while recording missing values and units.

zh.name: 统计助理
zh.summary: 统计助理按既定规则整理数据、计算汇总并准备图表，记录缺失值、单位与复核事项。
